title: AVP - Workday Product Owner
description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**


Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life\-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific.


Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi\-entity, multi\-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**


The Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end\-to\-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands\-on domain mastery role. You are the subject\-matter expert, the decision\-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi\-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.


Revantage hires multiple Product Owners, each covering a cluster of related modules. Example ownership areas include: (1\) Core HCM, Onboarding \& Workday Help; (2\) Compensation \& Advanced Compensation; (3\) Recruiting, Paradox \& HiredScore; (4\) Talent \& Learning; (5\) US Benefits \& US Payroll; (6\) People Analytics \& Peakon. While specific module assignments may vary, the role profile, expectations, and seniority level are consistent across all Product Owner positions.


This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player\-manager who both delivers and develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Domain Ownership \& Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s) end\-to\-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI\-powered tools, third\-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap \& Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo\-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi\-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt\-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands\-On Delivery**

* Remain hands\-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day\-to\-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem \& Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development (Future State)**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands\-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi\-entity, multi\-PortCo, or shared\-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi\-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**MODULE\-SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE (BY ROLE)**

title: HR Operations Associate
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an energetic and organised HR \& Operations Associate to join our Pune office. This is a close\-to\-the\-leadership role – you will work directly within the CEO’s office, giving you broad visibility across people functions, operational performance, and strategic reporting. You will be equally comfortable managing campus recruitment and employee engagement as you are pulling together productivity dashboards and presenting data to leadership. If you thrive at the intersection of people, operations, and communication – and you have a flair for content and social media – this role is built for you.

**CEO’s Office Support \& Operational Reporting**

A significant part of this role involves working directly with the Founder \& Director to ensure leadership has timely, accurate visibility into team performance, project status, and operational health.

**Productivity Tracking \& Analysis**

* Own the tracking and analysis of employee timesheets on a weekly and monthly basis – flagging gaps, patterns, and concerns proactively.
* Prepare structured productivity reports across employees, teams, and projects – covering utilisation, output against targets, and time allocation.
* Identify productivity bottlenecks and present data\-backed observations to the CEO with recommended actions.
* Maintain and evolve internal productivity tracking tools and templates in coordination with team leads.

**Dashboarding \& Presentation Support**

* Build and maintain CEO\-facing dashboards covering key numbers across active projects, team performance, headcount, and HR metrics.
* Prepare crisp, well\-structured presentation decks for internal reviews, team meetings, and leadership briefings.
* Consolidate inputs from across teams and translate them into clean, visual summaries suitable for decision\-making.
* Support the CEO in preparing materials for client interactions, partner meetings, or internal communications where operational data is required.

**Performance Appraisal Support**

* Assist team leaders and managers in running structured performance appraisal cycles – coordinating timelines, templates, and submissions.
* Compile and organise appraisal inputs, track completion, and present consolidated performance summaries to the CEO.
* Maintain performance history records and flag individuals requiring attention, development support, or recognition.

**Training, Upskilling \& Development Planning**

* Identify training needs across the team through productivity data, appraisal inputs, and direct observation.
* Plan and coordinate internal training sessions covering time management, productivity habits, communication, and role\-specific skills.
* Track participation, outcomes, and post\-training improvement across individuals and teams.
* Build an annual training and upskilling calendar aligned to business priorities and team growth goals.

**Recruitment \& Campus Engagement**

* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for internship and entry\-level roles across Pune\-based colleges and universities.
* Build and manage a strong campus network – TPOs, student bodies, and academic institutions – to create a consistent pipeline of talent.
* Plan and execute internship programmes, from onboarding through structured learning outcomes and performance review.
* Develop and maintain a recruitment tracker and candidate database to support hiring velocity.

**Employee Engagement \& Development**

* Design and run employee engagement initiatives, team activities, and recognition programmes within the office.
* Coordinate onboarding for new joiners and interns, ensuring a structured and welcoming experience.
* Support a positive and motivated office culture through regular engagement touchpoints and feedback loops.

**HR Operations \& Policy Management**

* Maintain and enforce office policies, attendance systems, and internal rules in coordination with leadership.
* Support documentation, HR records management, and process improvements across the people function.
* Act as the first point of contact for day\-to\-day HR queries from team members and interns.

**Social Media \& Internal Employer Branding**

* Own QLB’s HR and culture presence on LinkedIn and other relevant platforms – consistent posting, community building, and follower engagement.
* Create content showcasing our HR practices, employee engagement activities, team culture, and internship programme highlights.
* Produce short\-form videos and reels for internal and external employer branding – basic video editing skills are essential.
* Build and maintain a content calendar with a steady cadence of posts that reflect QLB’s values and workplace culture.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Graduate or postgraduate in HR, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA (HR) preferred but not mandatory.
* 0–2 years of experience; freshers with strong internship records, analytical ability, and social media skills are welcome.
* Comfortable working with data – timesheets, productivity metrics, and simple dashboards in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to create clean, structured presentations for leadership audiences.
* Genuine interest in people, campus recruitment, and building workplace culture.
* Comfortable with social media content creation – LinkedIn, Instagram, short\-form video.
* Basic video editing ability (Reels, CapCut, or similar tools).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Manager, Business Intelligence
description:
**Role description**  

#### **About Us**



Vistaprint Corporate Solutions (VCS) provides exciting career opportunities in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment that is simplifying how companies distribute brand\-consistent materials. As the B2B arm of VistaPrint, we continuously test ideas and make data\-driven decisions to deliver a peerless e\-commerce solution for our corporate customers. Our talented team of dedicated professionals is revolutionizing the custom print industry with our innovative ProShop platform – a custom\-branded storefront that empowers organizations to quickly and easily create, customize, and order any print or promotional product while maintaining brand control. Learn more about how you can contribute to our dynamic, growing company at VistaprintCorporate.com.

  


#### **About the Role**



During this important phase in our business growth, VCS is seeking a highly skilled and organized Business Intelligence Manager to lead a team of skilled analysts. In this role, you will serve as both a hands\-on leader and strategic manager, driving critical data governance and analytics initiatives while guiding a high\-performing analytics team. Advancing our journey, you will leverage automation and scalable solutions to establish and maintain a trusted single source of truth for VCS data, empowering stakeholders with the tools and insights needed to make informed decisions and reducing reliance on ad hoc reporting.



As a team leader, you will provide strategic direction and mentorship across the Sales Metrics Analysts, Business Analysts, and Product Analyst functions within VCS, ensuring alignment on priorities, data standards, reporting practices, and analytical insights that support organizational objectives and drive continuous improvement.



By providing a bridge between the sales department and other business units, such as marketing and finance, you will play a crucial role in aligning organizational goals with sales objectives. Are you characterized by a constant quest for improvement? Do you demand analytical prowess and a keen understanding of sales dynamics? This role will be stimulating and rewarding for those who are drawn to a career that melds analytical thinking with operational excellence and who thrives in roles that support and elevate both team and overall business performance.

  

**What You Will Do**


* **Architectural Leadership:** Design and partner with engineering to deliver high\-performance tables, dynamic views, and data pipelines, ensuring optimal query performance and scalability for Fulfillment Data Consumers.
* **Strategic Dashboarding:** Develop sophisticated, "at\-a\-glance" visualizations in Looker that translate trends and efficiencies into actionable insights.
* **AI Integration:** Leverage Snowflake Cortex to deploy LLM\-powered functions or predictive forecasting directly within our data platform.
* **Domain Expertise:** Analyze complex data to optimize fulfillment metrics, propose changes to our planning strategies, or help our fulfillment centers run more optimally.
* Provide leadership oversight to ensure that—across all the programs we're working on throughout VCS and with our cross\-functional stakeholders—we prioritize our work and resources effectively, measure impact, and deliver results.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Act as a consultant to leaders across Product Management, Sales, Finance, Systems Integrations, and others, transforming vague business questions into rigorous analytical frameworks and developing mutually beneficial working relationships.
  


#### **Qualifications \& Requirements**


* **Experience:** 7–12 years of progressive experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with a background in technical project/program management or product management.
* **Leadership:** 3\+ years of experience building and managing a team.
* **SQL Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in SQL.
* **Technical Stack:** Experience with JIRA and Advanced Dashboarding platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or Sigma).
* **AI/ML Familiarity:** Hands\-on experience (or strong theoretical knowledge) with Snowflake Cortex functions (e.g., COMPLETE, EXTRACT\_ANSWER, SUMMARIZE) or similar SQL\-based AI tools.
* **Visionary Execution:** Ability to work alongside senior leadership to set the tooling and system vision, improving operational efficiency and the overall quality of operations.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with product organizations, finance, and other business functions to design, implement, or integrate technical solutions.
* **Communication:** Experience communicating and translating non\-technical to technical (and vice versa) requirements and discussions, as well as coordinating and running multiple organizational projects.
* **Project Management:** The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with competing priorities, both as an IC and for your team.
* **Optimization \& Prioritization:** A keen eye for continuous optimization. You have the ability to discern the urgency and importance of work, find creative ways to use the full potential of our existing tools, and advocate for novel solutions.
* **Analytical Skills:** The ability to analyze data to identify the largest strategic opportunities for the organization and use data\-driven insights to provide high\-impact recommendations.

#### **Nice to Have**


* Familiarity with commercial business models and processes, including customer lifecycle management, sales and service operations, commission structures, and performance measurement.
* **Data and Analytics:** Python, SQL, Quantum Metrics, and Google Analytics
* **Data Platforms:** Experience with Snowflake, AWS and SAP.
* **Data Transformation:** Experience using DBT for transformation.
* **Version Control:** Experience using GIT.
* **BI/Dashboarding:** Experience using Looker.
  

  

**Skills**  

Data \& Analytics, AI/ML, Python, SQL, Jira, Database Management, leadership skills, Presentation skills.

 **About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

description:
The Production Operator position is an entry\-level position within the manufacturing area, primarily responsible for performing weigh\-up or packaging duties within the production department. Ensures the highest quality product at the lowest possible cost and meets customer specifications and delivery requirements in accordance with Avient policies and procedures.


  
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Obtains the correct documentation for the batch. Ensures the correct ingredients are delivered to the work area. May be required to obtain the correct ingredients for mixing and weigh out the ingredients to meet the recipe specifications.
* Sets up and starts any weigh\-up or packaging machinery, checking all controls for adherence to operating/safety procedures.
* Notifies appropriate personnel of any issues, problems or concerns in a timely manner.
* Safely and neatly processes, batch off, screen, cut up, package and/or skid material to correct size/container according to customer specifications.
* Accurately supplies/supports Production Operators with appropriate materials/functions to efficiently keep all equipment operational.
* Performs all required machine cleaning.
* Completes and maintains required paperwork and/or documents.
* Follows and complies with all safety and work rules and regulations. Maintains departmental housekeeping standards.
Other duties as assigned.  
* 

**Physical/Environ. Demands**

* Requires standing and sitting for extended periods of time, talking and listening.
* Must be able to walk and use hands. Occasionally requires bending, stooping, climbing ladders and stairs.
* May occasionally be required to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to frequently communicate and understand work instructions and information in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment where noise level is loud.
* Must be able to detect and discern safety alarms and respond accordingly.
* Generally, requires the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection, hard hat, respiratory protection.
* Exposure to outside weather conditions is routine.
* May be exposed to working in extreme heat and humidity.
May also be exposed on occasion to dust or fumes.  
* 

**Scope**

Manufacturing Plant


**Other**

Reports to: Plant Manager, Manufacturing Manager, Production Supervisor, Shift Supervisor/Lead, Production Lead.


  
**Qualification:**

* High School Diploma or GED
* Cross Functional \- Problem Solving Techniques
* Manufacturing \- Industrial Operations
* Manufacturing/Maintenance \- Fork Lift Operators License
* Personal Skills \- Manual Dexterity, Quantitative Skills, Reading/Comprehension, Conflict Resolution Skills

  
Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.  

  

Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.  

  

Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!  

  

We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.  

  

By *playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself* you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.  

  

At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

title: Lease & Portfolio Management Lead
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Real Estate Manager *At ABB, we help industries outrun \- leaner and**cleaner**. Here, progress is an expectation \- for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader,**we’ll**give you what you need to make it happen. It**won’t**always be**easy;**growing takes grit. But at ABB,**you’ll**never run alone. Run what runs the world**.*

  

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are establishing a Lease and Portfolio Management Center of Excellence (CoE) within our Global Real Estate function and are hiring a new Lease \& Portfolio Management Lead to build and lead this capability.

  

Our Real Estate function’s objective is to effectively support ABB’s business activities by securing the most efficient and profitable use of ABB’s real estate facilities/assets. This requires local, professional real estate expertise to ensure optimum results across all Business Areas and Divisions. As the Global Lease and Portfolio Manager, you will work within a collaborative environment reporting directly to the Business Area Real Estate Manager for Motion supporting all Business Areas across all countries.


This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main ABB facilities.

  



This role reports to our global Head of Real Estate.

  

This newly created role combines strategic leadership with operational execution. With this role you will design, implement, and run a centralized framework for lease administration and portfolio management, ensuring accuracy, consistency, compliance, and transparency across the global real estate portfolio.


The role is well suited to someone who enjoys creating structure, collaborating across Finance, Legal, and Real Estate, and serving as the single source of truth for lease and portfolio data.

 **Key Responsibilities**  



**Center of Excellence Setup \& Governance**

* Design and implement the Lease \& Portfolio Management Center of Excellence, including scope, operating model, governance, and KPIs
* Define and document global standards, processes, and controls for lease and portfolio management
* Act as the global subject matter expert for lease and portfolio management topics
**Lease Administration \& Portfolio Management**

* Lead the implementation of a new lease and portfolio management tool
* Own end‑to‑end lease administration activities across the global portfolio, including:
* Lease abstraction and data validation
* Critical date management (renewals, expiries, options)
* Rent, escalation, indexation, and payment tracking
* Compliance with lease terms and contractual obligations
* Maintain a global view of the real estate lease portfolio, supporting transparency, optimization, and decision‑making
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across lease and portfolio management systems
* Build and develop a centralized lease and portfolio management team, as the CoE matures
**Stakeholder \&****Cross**‑**Functional****Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Real Estate, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Tax, and Procurement
* Support financial close activities, audits, and reporting (including lease accounting inputs under applicable standards)
* Act as a key interface with external service providers and landlords
**Continuous Improvement \& Digitization**

* Drive process efficiency, standardization, and automation across lease and portfolio management
* Support selection, implementation, and optimization of digital tools and systems
* Develop portfolio dashboards and reporting to enhance transparency, insights, and decision‑making
* Risk, Compliance \& Controls
* Establish and maintain internal controls related to lease and portfolio management
* Identify risks, inconsistencies, or compliance gaps and drive remediation
 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
* 10\+ years of experience in lease administration, real estate operations, or portfolio management, preferably in a global environment
* Proven experience establishing or transforming processes, operating models, or shared\-service capabilities
* Strong understanding of commercial lease structures, terminology, data requirements, and governance practices
* Hands\-on experience with lease and portfolio management systems, including implementation, optimization, or data quality improvement
* Familiarity with lease accounting requirements, such as IFRS 16 or ASC 842, and experience supporting audits, reporting, or financial close activities
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience partnering across Real Estate, Finance, Legal, and external service providers
* Structured, detail\-oriented, and data\-driven, with the ability to operate hands\-on, think strategically, manage ambiguity, and build new capabilities with integrity and ownership

Job description:

**Job Description (JD) – Product Development Manager (FMCG)Position:** Product Development Manager

**Company:** HR Exports Private Limited  
**Brand:** Shazia Rice  
**Industry:** FMCG (Food \& Rice Products)  
**Experience:** 8–10 Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Product Development, Food Technology, Food Science, Business Management, or a related field.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Reporting To**

**Director / Business Head**

**About HR Exports Private Limited**

**HR Exports Private Limited**, the company behind the trusted **Shazia Rice** brand, is a leading manufacturer and marketer of premium\-quality rice products in the FMCG sector. We are committed to delivering innovative, high\-quality products that meet evolving consumer preferences and market demands.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic **Product Development Manager** to drive new product innovation and portfolio expansion for the **Shazia Rice** brand. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in FMCG product development, market research, consumer insights, competitor benchmarking, and vendor management. This role requires identifying emerging market opportunities, developing successful products, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely product launches.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in **Product Development**, **Food Technology**, **Food Science**, **Business Management**, or a related field.
* 8–10 years of experience in Product Development within the **FMCG industry**.
* Experience in food products, packaged foods, or rice products will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Development**

* Lead end\-to\-end product development from concept to commercial launch.
* Identify new product opportunities based on market trends and consumer demand.
* Develop innovative FMCG food products aligned with business objectives.
* Improve existing products to enhance quality, packaging, pricing, and customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate product trials, testing, and commercial production.

**Market Research**

* Conduct in\-depth research on FMCG market trends, consumer behavior, and emerging product categories.
* Gather customer insights to identify unmet market needs.
* Evaluate new business opportunities and recommend product expansion strategies.

**Product Research**

* Research ingredients, formulations, packaging materials, and product innovations.
* Study domestic and international food trends for product development.
* Analyze product performance and recommend improvements.

**Competitor Analysis**

* Monitor competitors' product portfolios, pricing strategies, packaging, promotions, and market positioning.
* Conduct benchmarking studies to identify competitive advantages.
* Prepare detailed competitor analysis reports with actionable recommendations.

**Vendor Management \& Negotiation**

* Identify and develop new vendors for raw materials, packaging, and product components.
* Negotiate pricing, quality standards, commercial terms, and delivery schedules.
* Build long\-term relationships with suppliers to ensure cost efficiency and consistent quality.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Procurement, Production, Quality Assurance, Marketing, Sales, and Supply Chain teams.
* Support product launches by providing technical and commercial inputs.
* Ensure seamless coordination from product concept to market launch.

**Compliance \& Quality**

* Ensure products comply with FSSAI and other applicable food safety regulations.
* Maintain product documentation, specifications, and SOPs.
* Support quality improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills**

* Strong FMCG market research and consumer insights.
* Product research and innovation expertise.
* Competitor analysis and market benchmarking.
* Vendor sourcing and negotiation skills.
* Product lifecycle management.
* Commercial awareness and product costing.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Project management and cross\-functional coordination.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful launch of new FMCG products.
* Product development projects completed within timelines.
* Revenue contribution from newly launched products.
* Improvement in product quality and customer satisfaction.
* Market share growth through innovative products.
* Cost optimization through effective vendor negotiations.
* Competitive benchmarking and implementation of market insights.

The ideal candidate should have proven expertise in:

* **Research in the FMCG market** to identify trends, customer needs, and growth opportunities.
* **Product research** for developing innovative and commercially viable products.
* **Competitor analysis** to evaluate pricing, packaging, positioning, and product strategies.
* **Vendor negotiations** to achieve the best commercial terms while ensuring quality and timely supply.
* Strong understanding of the FMCG product lifecycle and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment with a results\-driven approach.

**Why Join HR Exports Private Limited – Shazia Rice?**

* Opportunity to build and expand an established FMCG food brand.
* Lead innovative product development initiatives with significant business impact.
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, and growth\-focused environment.
* Competitive compensation and career advancement opportunities.
* Exposure to product innovation, market expansion, and strategic business development.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

description:
Lincoln International, Inc. (NYSE: LCLN) is a trusted investment banking advisor to business owners and senior executives of leading private equity firms and their portfolio companies and to public and privately held companies. Our services include mergers and acquisitions advisory, private funds and capital markets advisory, and valuations and fairness opinions. The global enterprise is comprised of a tightly integrated team of more than 1,400 professionals in more than 30 offices in 14 countries, offering an unobstructed perspective on the global private capital markets, backed by superb execution and a deep commitment to client success. With extensive industry knowledge and relationships, timely market intelligence and strategic insights, we forge deep, productive client relationships that endure for decades. Connect with us to learn more at www.lincolninternational.com.
   

  

 At Lincoln International, we know that the success of our global organization is a direct outcome of the strength of our people. We encourage diversity of thought and create talent density by attracting, retaining and engaging high performers from all demographics, backgrounds and perspectives. We value diversity, equity and inclusion as a catalyst to foster innovation and creative problem solving, access the best candidates and adapt to a highly dynamic, competitive environment. We know that employing a diverse team and valuing the unique perspectives of our people allows us to better understand and serve the needs of our clients.
   

  

 Lincoln International is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to read more about our commitment to diversity and Environmental, Social \& Governance (ESG) efforts.
   

  

**Lincoln International follows a hybrid work structure with an emphasis on in office collaboration.
   

  

 Our employees work in our offices Monday through Thursday each week, with the option to work remotely or from the office on Fridays.**
**Duties \& Responsibilities:**
 We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR Director, Emerging Markets to lead and support our human resources function across India, Japan, China, Dubai, and Brazil. Working closely with the Global Talent team headquartered in Chicago, Illinois USA, this role ensures that global HR strategies, policies, and processes are in alignment with business objectives while remaining compliant with local employment laws and regulations.
   

  

 The HR Director will oversee core HR functions including employee relations, compliance with local legal requirements, talent management, performance management, and HR operations across multiple jurisdictions. This role requires a strong understanding of regional HR practices, the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments, and experience working with distributed global teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Regional HR Leadership
   

  

* Serve as the primary HR leader for Lincoln’s emerging markets, supporting business leaders and employees across multiple locations while helping to build and scale HR programs, processes, and infrastructure to support the firm’s continued growth.
* Lead, develop, and oversee a team of HR professionals across emerging markets, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure consistent delivery of HR programs and services.
* Partner with global HR leadership to implement and execute HR strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Establish, enhance, and standardize HR processes, policies, and programs across the region, balancing local market needs with global consistency and best practices.
* Provide guidance to managers on organizational design, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Partner with the Global Talent, Finance, and business leadership teams to create and support compensation programs across the region, including market benchmarking, salary review processes, compensation planning, and the application of compensation best practices while ensuring alignment with local market conditions and the firm’s global compensation philosophy.
* Serve as a confidential resource for employees and leaders.
* Assist in the management of the annual budget as it relates to spend on benefits, wellness, high\-level compensation and employee relations matters, working in tandem with Lincoln’s Finance function.


 Employee Relations \& HR Advisory
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to management and senior leaders across emerging markets on employee relations matters, performance management, and workplace issues.
* Manage and resolve complex employee relations matters while ensuring consistency with company policies and local regulations.
* Promote a positive and inclusive workplace culture across regional offices.


 Compliance \& HR Policy Management
   

  

* Stay current on labor laws, employment regulations, and HR best practices across emerging markets and keep global HR informed where needed.
* Ensure company policies, procedures, and practices remain compliant with regional legal requirements.
* Create and maintain required documentation along the employee lifecycle (e.g., employee leave documentation, transfer letters, separation documents, etc.).
* Partner with Manager of Employee Relations and global Legal (or local outside counsel) on employment\-related matters, investigations, and risk mitigation


 HR Operations \& Systems
   

  

* Support and maintain HR processes and data integrity within HR systems, including Workday.
* Partner with the global HRIS team to implement system improvements and ensure effective use of HR technology.
* Oversee regional HR reporting and analytics to support decision\-making.


 Talent \& Performance Management
   

  

* Support performance management processes, employee development initiatives, and succession planning.
* Partner with leadership to identify and develop high\-potential talent across the region.
* Assist in recruitment and onboarding strategies as needed.


 Cultural Ambassador
   

  

* Oversee the Mumbai office experience, including day\-to\-day employee engagement, leadership visibility.
* Serve as a cultural representative, helping shape and sustain Lincoln’s value\-driven environment.


 Global Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with HR colleagues across the Americas, EMEA, and other regions to ensure consistency in global HR practices while adapting to local needs.
* Contribute to global HR initiatives and cross\-regional projects.


**Qualifications:**
* 7\+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Significant HR experience supporting employees and business leaders in India is required; experience supporting employees and business leaders at a multinational organization across APAC markets, with exposure to Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and broader Middle East employment practices preferred.
* Strong understanding of regional labor laws, compliance requirements, and HR best practices.
* Experience working with HRIS systems, preferably Workday.
* Proven ability to partner with senior leadership and influence decision\-making.
* Strong employee relations experience, including handling sensitive workplace matters.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience working in a global or multinational organization.
* Experience supporting HR operations across multiple countries simultaneously.

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.


* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

**Role summary**  
We are hiring an experienced Cloud Trainer to deliver hands\-on instructor\-led sessions on Google Cloud Platform and multi\-cloud fundamentals (GCP, AWS, Azure awareness). You will train learners to deploy, run, and operate applications and ML workloads on cloud platforms, focusing on practical labs and project support. This is a steady part\-time role with fixed monthly pay, ideal for working cloud engineers or freelancers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Deliver instructor\-led, hands\-on training on GCP core services and cloud deployment workflows.
* Teach containerization (Docker), basic orchestration concepts (GKE/Kubernetes overview), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code fundamentals (Terraform).
* Cover essential AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC) and basic Azure awareness to provide multi\-cloud context.
* Teach GCP for AI/ML: Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, and ML pipeline basics using Cloud Build.
* Guide learners through deploying full\-stack apps and ML models to the cloud; provide active project support and troubleshooting.
* Design and run lab exercises using GCP Console and CLI; ensure sessions are hands\-on rather than slide\-heavy.
* Coordinate with in\-house technical mentors to align cloud training with coding curriculum and project timelines.
* Maintain up\-to\-date practical knowledge of cloud services and incorporate real\-world use cases.

**Required qualifications and skills**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on, professional experience using GCP in production or client projects (practical experience required; not only coursework).
* Currently using GCP in your job or freelance engagements (knowledge must be current).
* Strong working knowledge of: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions/Run, IAM, VPC, BigQuery.
* Regular Docker usage: building images, running containers, basic debugging, pushing to registries.
* Experience with at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Jenkins, etc.) and at least one pipeline implemented end\-to\-end.
* Basic AWS knowledge: EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC — sufficient to teach fundamentals and cross\-cloud concepts.
* Comfortable with Linux command line, SSH, and basic troubleshooting.
* GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification (or willingness to obtain within 3 months).
* Strong communication and teaching ability in English; experience explaining complex topics to freshers.
* Based in Hyderabad and available to attend Cyber Towers daily for the agreed half\-day shift.

**Desirable (good to have)**

* Hands\-on Terraform experience (IaC: plan, apply, modules).
* Kubernetes / GKE practical experience.
* Familiarity with Azure basics (VMs, App Services, AKS) to support multi\-cloud comparisons.
* Experience with monitoring tools (Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Deeper networking knowledge (load balancers, DNS, firewalls, SSL/TLS).
* Prior training, mentoring, or teaching experience.
* Multiple cloud certifications (GCP \+ AWS).

**What we offer**

* Predictable, reliable part\-time schedule: 4 hours/day, allowing continued main\-job commitments.
* Minimum 6\-month engagement with opportunity for extension based on performance and business needs.
* Professional on\-site environment at Cyber Towers, Hyderabad.
* Opportunity to build a profile as a cloud trainer and mentor.

The Fitter / Plumber is responsible for installing, repairing, maintaining, and testing plumbing systems, pipelines, pumps, valves, and related equipment at project sites. The role ensures all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project drawings, specifications, and quality standards.

**Key ResponsibilitiesInstallation Works**

* Install GI, MS, CPVC, UPVC, HDPE, PPR, PVC, and SS pipelines.
* Install water supply, drainage, sewage, rainwater, and fire\-fighting pipelines.
* Install valves, pumps, tanks, fixtures, fittings, and plumbing accessories.
* Assemble and fit pipe supports, brackets, hangers, and clamps.
* Perform pipe cutting, threading, grooving, bending, and jointing.
* Read and execute plumbing drawings, layouts, and isometric drawings.

**Maintenance \& Repair**

* Repair leaking pipelines, valves, joints, pumps, and plumbing fixtures.
* Carry out preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Replace damaged pipes and fittings.
* Attend emergency plumbing complaints promptly.
* Ensure uninterrupted water supply systems.

**Testing \& Commissioning**

* Perform hydro testing and pressure testing.
* Check for leakages and rectify defects.
* Assist in commissioning plumbing systems.
* Verify proper flow, pressure, and drainage performance.

**Quality Control**

* Ensure installation follows approved drawings.
* Maintain proper alignment and slope of pipelines.
* Ensure neat workmanship.
* Report material shortages and quality issues.
* Rectify punch list items before project handover.

**Material Handling**

* Verify received plumbing materials.
* Maintain material consumption records.
* Minimize wastage of pipes and fittings.
* Store tools and materials properly.

**Safety Responsibilities**

* Follow all company safety procedures.
* Wear mandatory PPE (Helmet, Safety Shoes, Gloves, Goggles).
* Maintain a clean and safe work area.
* Report unsafe conditions immediately.
* Follow permit\-to\-work requirements where applicable.

**Housekeeping**

* Keep work area clean before and after work.
* Dispose of waste materials properly.
* Return tools to the designated storage area.

**Documentation**

* Maintain daily work progress.
* Report completed work to the Site Engineer.
* Record maintenance activities.
* Assist in site inspections and audits.

**Skills Required**

* Pipe fitting and plumbing installation.
* Pipe cutting, threading, welding coordination, and jointing.
* Pump installation and maintenance.
* Valve installation and servicing.
* Ability to read engineering drawings.
* Knowledge of plumbing standards.
* Problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Teamwork and communication.

**Educational Qualification**

* ITI – Plumber / Fitter
* Diploma (Preferred)

**Experience**

* **Fresher to 2 Years** – Junior Fitter/Plumber
* **3–5 Years** – Fitter/Plumber
* **5\+ Years** – Senior Fitter/Plumber

**Technical Knowledge**

* Water Supply Systems
* Drainage Systems
* Sewage Systems
* Fire Fighting Pipelines
* Pump Installation
* Valve Installation
* Pipe Threading
* Hydro Testing
* Pressure Testing
* Plumbing Drawings
* Preventive Maintenance

**Tools Knowledge**

* Pipe Threading Machine
* Pipe Cutter
* Grinder
* Drilling Machine
* Pipe Wrench
* Measuring Tape
* Spirit Level
* Pressure Testing Pump
* Chain Wrench
* Adjustable Wrench

* Daily work completion as per schedule.
* Zero rework due to installation errors.
* Timely completion of assigned activities.
* Minimal material wastage.
* Compliance with safety standards.
* Good housekeeping at the work area.
* Prompt resolution of plumbing issues.
* Proper maintenance of tools and equipment.

**Working Conditions**

* Work at construction and project sites.
* Ability to work outdoors and at heights when required.
* Willingness to work overtime or shifts during project requirements.
* Travel to different project locations as assigned.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Responsible and disciplined.
* Good physical fitness.
* Strong troubleshooting skills.
* Positive attitude and teamwork.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Commitment to quality and safety.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to project requirements.

title: Technician
description:
**Electrical Technician**

**Job Summary:**

The **Electrical Technician** is responsible for assembling, wiring, testing, installing, and maintaining electrical panels, control systems, and related equipment at ORAIPL. The role involves hands\-on work in panel wiring, field installation, troubleshooting, and ensuring adherence to electrical drawings, safety standards, and quality requirements. The position requires strong technical skills, precision, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team to support production and project execution.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**1\. Electrical Panel Wiring \& Assembly**

* Assemble and wire control panels, MCCs, and automation panels as per engineering drawings and wiring diagrams.
* Identify, mark, and terminate wires and components correctly according to schematics.
* Install electrical accessories like switches, relays, MCBs, contactors, PLCs, VFDs, and meters.
* Ensure neat and standardized wiring practices in all electrical panels.

**2\. Installation \& Commissioning Support**

* Assist in the installation of electrical panels, cabling, and field wiring at project sites.
* Support engineers during commissioning of automation and electrical systems.
* Conduct electrical terminations, cable tray routing, and earthing as per design and safety standards.
* Perform continuity checks, insulation tests, and functional testing before energizing systems.

**3\. Maintenance \& Troubleshooting**

* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical panels, motors, control systems, and instruments.
* Identify faults and carry out troubleshooting in wiring, controls, and power circuits.
* Support service teams in attending to breakdowns or customer complaints.
* Replace or repair defective components as instructed by the electrical engineer or manager.

**4\. Quality \& Safety Compliance**

* Follow standard electrical wiring practices and company quality procedures.
* Ensure all electrical work complies with safety standards (IS/IEC).
* Use proper PPE and tools during all electrical and site activities.
* Report any unsafe conditions, incidents, or equipment faults immediately.

**5\. Documentation \& Coordination**

* Maintain job cards, wiring checklists, and inspection reports for completed panels.
* Update engineers on daily progress and material requirements.
* Support QA/QC inspections and incorporate feedback for improvement.
* Ensure all tools and equipment are properly maintained and calibrated.

**6\. Material \& Inventory Management**

* Verify receipt of electrical materials and components as per bill of materials (BOM).
* Inform the purchase or stores team about shortages or damaged materials.
* Ensure efficient use of materials and minimize wastage during wiring and installation.

**Skills \& Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of **electrical wiring, panel assembly, and testing procedures.**
* Ability to read and interpret **electrical drawings, schematics, and circuit diagrams.**
* Familiarity with **industrial control components** (contactors, relays, PLCs, VFDs, MCCBs, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience in **panel wiring, motor connections, and cable termination.**
* Good understanding of **industrial safety practices.**
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet production deadlines.

**Qualification \& Experience:**

* **Education:** ITI / Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
* **Experience: Freshers** can apply. Internship or hands\-on experience in electrical panel wiring, assembly, and industrial electrical systems will be preferred.
* **Preferred:** Experience with **PLC panels, MCC panels, and on\-site electrical installation.**

 Join us as Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

* Agile Delivery \& Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Position:** Research Writer ( MPharmacy)  
**Location:** Panchkula  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Entry\-Level Candidates Welcome  
**Qualification:** Master's in Pharmacy Degree or PhD (Freshers can apply)  
**Reporting To:** Department Head

About the Role

We are looking for enthusiastic and detail\-oriented **Research Writers** to join our growing team. This role is ideal for **Master's in Pharmacy and PhD freshers** who have a strong interest in academic research, publication writing, data analysis, and scholarly communication. Candidates with excellent analytical abilities and **good communication skills** will have the opportunity to work on research projects across multiple disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct comprehensive literature reviews and academic research across various domains.
* Prepare, write, edit, and proofread high\-quality research papers, review articles, and academic manuscripts.
* Support researchers and clients throughout the research publication process.
* Analyze research data using statistical tools such as **SPSS**, Excel, Python, or R.
* Interpret research findings and present results in a clear and professional manner.
* Identify suitable journals and ensure compliance with publication guidelines and standards.
* Coordinate manuscript submissions, revisions, and communication with journal editors.
* Collaborate with internal teams and subject matter experts to maintain research quality and accuracy.
* Stay updated with current research methodologies, publication standards, and industry trends.

Required Qualifications

* **Master's Degree in Pharmacy**
* **Freshers are encouraged to apply.**
* Prior experience in research projects, thesis writing, dissertations, or publications will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of academic research methodologies and publication processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking abilities.
* Must have published one research or review in any journal .

Technical Skills

* **SPSS** for statistical analysis and data interpretation.
* Knowledge of **Python** and/or **R Programming**.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Data Analysis and Research Methodology.
* Academic Writing and Publication Management.
* Opportunity for **Master's in Pharmacy and PhD freshers** to build a career in research and publication.
* Hands\-on exposure to international research and journal publication processes.
* Learning and development opportunities in academic writing, data analysis, and research consulting.
* Dynamic and growth\-oriented work culture.
* Professional networking and career advancement opportunities.

This position is an excellent opportunity for **Research Writers, Master's graduates, and PhD freshers** looking to develop expertise in academic research, publication support, data analysis, and **SPSS\-based research projects**.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹27,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Have you published any research paper and review article in any journal ?

Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst II
description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Verification \& Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market\-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.
   

  

 VRMO designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly analytical and result\-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.
   

  

 We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real\-time and close to real\-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.
   

  

 Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self\-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.
* Communication skills – ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories
* Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation
* Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau
* Ability to translate ambiguous work\-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks.
* Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience gathering business requirements, using industry standard business intelligence tool(s) to extract data, formulate metrics and build reports
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* 1\+ years of relational database technology (such as Redshift, Oracle, MySQL or MS SQL) experience
* 
* Familiarity with optimization, planning and logistics concepts – gained through work experience or education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience with SQL and database technologies such as AWS Redshift and expertise in performance tuning and scaling in a DWH environment
* Knowledge of at least one data visualization product (Tableau, Looker, Amazon QuickSight, etc.)
* Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
* Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data\-driven business decisions


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Software Test Engineer(Automation/Manual)
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented Software Testing Engineer with experience in Automotive Software Testing and Manual Testing. The candidate will be responsible for validating software applications, identifying defects, ensuring compliance with automotive quality standards, and maintaining comprehensive test documentation. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of software testing methodologies within the automotive domain.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and execute manual test cases based on business and functional requirements.

Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing.

Validate automotive software applications, embedded systems, and related modules.

Identify, document, track, and report software defects using defect management tools.

Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test reports, and traceability matrices.
