title: HR Manager, India
description:
**Role purpose**


Our people are our most important asset and it is the role of the HR Manager to support the business in providing a happy and productive workplace where everyone can work to their full potential, feel included in the workplace and engaged with the business.  

  

The HR Manager, India is responsible for delivering a compliant, commercially focused and high\-quality HR service across the region. Acting as the key escalation point from the HR Shared Service Centre, the role leads on complex employee relations matters, ensures adherence to local labour laws, and provides data\-driven insight on employee sentiment and engagement to inform business decisions.  

  

The role works in close partnership with HR Business Partners, focusing on local delivery, employee relations expertise, and in\-country insight.  

  

The role partners with regional and global HR teams to ensure India requirements are represented in projects, policies, and initiatives, while continuously improving the employee experience in\-market.

 **Role tasks and responsibilities**


Employee Experience, Engagement \& Insight  

 Build a strong understanding of employee sentiment, engagement levels, and retention drivers across India  

 Complete exit interviews with senior employees and analyse data across all employee exits in India capturing valuable insight and making recommendations for improvements  

 Analyse local data (e.g. engagement surveys, attrition trends, ER cases) to identify themes and risks  

 Recommend and drive targeted initiatives to improve engagement, inclusion, and overall employee experience  

 Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on people\-related challenges and opportunities  

  

Employee Relations and Case Management  

 Act as key interface between the HR Shared Service Centre (SSC) and the India business  

 Ensure effective handling and resolution of escalated queries, maintaining service quality and timeliness  

 Act as the primary escalation point for complex employee relations cases, taking responsibility to manage sensitive and high\-risk cases (disciplinary, grievance, performance, exits) ensuring consistency, fairness, and legal compliance  

 Provide feedback to the SSC on recurring issues, process gaps, and improvement opportunities based on trends in case data  

 Support continuous improvement of HR processes, service delivery, and knowledge management  

  

Compliance \& Local Employment Law  

 Ensure compliance with all applicable India labour laws and regulations, including ongoing monitoring of legislative changes  

 Translate local legal requirements into practical HR policies, processes, and guidance for the business  

 Support audits, risk mitigation, and documentation standards in line with statutory requirements  

 Identify, assess, and mitigate people\-related risks, escalating issues where required to protect the organisation from legal and reputational exposure  

 Partner with legal (internal/external) on complex or high\-risk employment matters  

 Provide oversight and guidance on immigration and visa\-related matters where required  

  

Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Support  

 Develop effective working relationships with local leadership to support delivery of business objectives  

 Provide input on organisational changes, workforce planning, and talent considerations from an India perspective  

 Coach and support line managers in building strong, engaged, and compliant teams  

 Support change initiatives, ensuring appropriate communication and local alignment  

 Provide expert guidance and coaching to managers on ER matters and local employment legislation  

 Work closely with the Talent Development Manager to ensure training programs are carried out on the ground as per the global/regional training agenda  

  

Regional \& Global HR Projects  

 Contribute India insights and requirements into regional and global HR initiatives providing adaptations where required to fit the practical and cultural needs of the business  

 Support the implementation of global HR programmes (e.g. performance management, reward, DE\&I, policy harmonisation)  

 Ensure local adaptation of global frameworks where required to meet regulatory and cultural needs  

 Lead or contribute to HR projects at a regional level as required

 **Requirements** **Knowledge and experience**


Essential


 Proven experience in a HR Manager or senior HR Generalist role within India


 Strong knowledge of India employment law (particularly India) and its practical application


 Extensive experience managing complex employee relations cases


 Experience working within or alongside HR Shared Service models


 Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills


 Ability to balance commercial priorities with risk and compliance considerations


 Experience of using HR Information Systems and Microsoft packages


 Experience of working within an international environment


 Experience of working in a matrix structure and with remote colleagues


 Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy in a geographically dispersed environment


Preferred


 Experience in professional services or multinational environments


 Exposure to global HR operating models and transformation initiatives


 Strong analytical and data interpretation capability

**Qualifications and specialist skills**


 CIPD or equivalent


 Able to actively listen, communicate, network, engage with and influence people at all levels of the organisation, building strong working relationships with managers


 Able to address issues constructively by providing independent, objective and commercial advice

description:
Job Description – CNC Operator / VTL Operator

**Position:** CNC Operator  
**Department:** Production / Manufacturing  
**Location:** Kuppepalayam,Kovilpalayam,Coimbatore  
**Reports to:** Production Supervisor / Shift In\-Charge

**Amenities : Room and food free, Yearly 34 days leave With Salary, ESI \& PF \& 1 Month Bonus ,Referral Bonus Etc...**

**Job Purpose**

The CNC Operator is responsible for operating, setting up, and maintaining CNC machines to produce precision components as per engineering drawings, quality standards, and production schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up and operate CNC machines (lathe, milling, turning, or grinding) according to specifications.
* Interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and work instructions to determine machining requirements.
* Load raw materials and tooling, ensuring correct alignment and positioning.
* Monitor machine operations to detect malfunctions or deviations and make necessary adjustments.

* Carry out preventive maintenance and daily machine checks to ensure proper functioning.
* Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized work environment.
* Record production data, job reports, and downtime logs.
* Collaborate with supervisors and engineers to improve machining processes and reduce rework.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* 10,12th / ITI/Diploma in Mechanical / Production Engineering or equivalent.
* 1–3 years of experience operating CNC machines (Fresher with training can also be considered).
* Knowledge of G\-code, M\-code, and CNC programming basics preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD\&T.
* Skilled in using measuring instruments and precision tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Willingness to work in shifts and under production deadlines.

**Key Competencies**

* Technical aptitude and mechanical knowledge.
* Quality\-conscious mindset.
* Teamwork and communication skills.
* Discipline and adherence to safety standards.

description:

Headquartered in Bangalore with an office in Dubai and Singapore, our ‘Global’ loyalty solution has been built after years of deep understanding of consumers, the nuances of the loyalty diaspora, the onset of big data, and most important the simplicity that needs to be delivered across any loyalty program.** **Our Technology, Marketing, Alliances, Business, Product, and Operations teams work in collaboration to create and deliver the most successful loyalty programs in India today. With over 2000\+ retail alliances in India and access to over 10 million rewards globally, gives us the edge to be one of the most exciting and growing loyalty company in Asia.** **The only constant in today’s difficult and dynamic market is 'change'. Our team is dedicated to using behavioral patterns of customers combined with cutting edge technology to take complex problems that enterprises face today and simplify them. This helps make our programs more relevant and puts the customer on the path of true loyalty.** **About the Role**
We are looking for a proactive and technically curious IT Support Intern to join our growing Infrastructure team at Reward360\. This is a hands\-on internship where you will work alongside senior IT professionals to resolve technical issues, support day\-to\-day IT operations, and assist with hardware maintenance. You will gain real\-world exposure in an enterprise IT environment — building a strong foundation for a career in IT support or systems administration. **Key Responsibilities*** Provide first\-level technical support (L1\) to employees for hardware, software, and network\-related issues via helpdesk, email, or in\-person.

* Diagnose and replace faulty hardware components such as RAM, HDD/SSD, keyboards, screens, and power units.
* Set up and troubleshoot peripherals — monitors, printers, scanners, and projectors.
* Perform routine hardware maintenance including cleaning, inspection, and minor repairs.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (primarily Windows 10/11\).
* Assist in onboarding new employees — device setup, account creation, and access provisioning.
* Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi\-Fi infrastructure, and basic network devices.
* Log and track all IT support tickets in the helpdesk system; escalate unresolved issues to seniors.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets — hardware, peripherals, and software licenses.
* Support the IT team with patch management, system health checks, and data backup procedures.
* Document troubleshooting steps and maintain a knowledge base for common issues.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications*** Any Graduate or Diploma holder in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field — freshers are welcome.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components (RAM, HDD, motherboard, SMPS, etc.) and the ability to identify and replace common parts.
* Comfortable working with Windows OS (10/11\); exposure to macOS or Linux is a plus.
* Familiarity with networking basics — IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN concepts.
* Ability to set up and troubleshoot peripherals such as printers, monitors, and scanners.
* Good communication skills and a helpful, patient attitude toward end users.
* Willingness to learn, take initiative, and work as part of a team.

 **Good to Have (Not Mandatory)*** Basic knowledge of Active Directory, Office 365, or G Suite.
* Any short\-term IT certification — Hardware \& Networking, CompTIA A\+, or Microsoft Fundamentals.
* Prior hands\-on experience from college labs, personal projects, or informal IT support.

title: Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: Workplace Service Delivery Associate Manager-Events
description:
**Job Title: Senior Specialist \[CL 8] – Event Management**  

**Location:** Bangalore  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, In Office on all days

**Department:** Accenture Workplace Services

**Reports to:** Workplace Event Management Manager \[CL 7]

 **Position Overview**:


The Event Planning \& Management, Senior Specialist is responsible for leading the strategy, planning, and execution of internal and client\-facing events that enhance workplace experience, strengthen brand presence, and support business objectives across our IT Services organization.


Operating within the Workplace \& Facilities function, this role ensures seamless delivery of events across corporate offices, innovation hubs, and hybrid environments. The Senior Specialist will drive operational excellence, governance, vendor partnerships, and continuous improvement across all event programs while aligning with corporate standards, compliance requirements, and cost optimization goals.


This role requires a strategic thinker with strong operational execution capabilities, cross\-functional leadership skills, and experience managing events within a corporate or technology\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership:**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive workplace events strategy aligned with corporate, HR, and business unit objectives.
* Establish scalable event frameworks and standards across regional offices and global locations.
* Define KPIs to measure event effectiveness, employee engagement impact, ROI, and cost efficiency.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance event quality, sustainability, and innovation.
* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for workplace and corporate events within the organization.
* Identify emerging trends in corporate, hybrid, and technology\-enabled events.

**Event Management:**

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of internal and external events, including town halls, leadership summits, client engagements, workplace activations, and cultural initiatives.
* Oversee logistics including venue coordination, A/V, IT infrastructure setup, security, catering, branding, and facilities readiness.
* Manage onsite event operations and troubleshoot real\-time issues.
* Ensure compliance with health \& safety, security, and IT standards.
* Develop event timelines, run\-of\-show documentation, and contingency plans.
* Support hybrid and virtual event integration in collaboration with IT teams.

**Event Planning \& Optimization:**

* Standardize event intake, planning workflows, and resource allocation processes.
* Develop event playbooks, templates, and SOPs for consistency and scalability.
* Implement technology tools for event registration, tracking, and analytics.
* Optimize space utilization within corporate offices for events.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives through forecasting, budgeting, and vendor consolidation.
* Conduct post\-event analysis and apply lessons learned to future planning.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Partner with HR, Marketing, Communications, IT, Security, and Business Leaders to align event objectives.
* Support executive leadership events with high\-touch coordination and confidentiality.
* Collaborate with Real Estate and Facilities teams to ensure venue readiness and compliance.
* Work closely with IT teams to support technical infrastructure needs (A/V, connectivity, digital signage).
* Align with Corporate Communications for branding and messaging consistency.
* Coordinate with Finance for budgeting, procurement, and expense management.

**Governance \& Reporting:**

* Establish governance frameworks for event approvals, budget controls, and compliance.
* Track and report on event performance metrics, cost savings, and operational KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to corporate procurement policies and risk management protocols.
* Maintain documentation and audit\-ready records for contracts, insurance, and compliance.
* Develop executive\-level dashboards and reporting summaries.
* Monitor sustainability and ESG considerations in event execution.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

* Manage relationships with event vendors, venues, caterers, A/V providers, and logistics partners.
* Negotiate contracts and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Develop preferred vendor programs to improve service consistency and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage event\-related assets (furniture, technology, branding materials, digital equipment).
* Conduct vendor performance reviews and maintain scorecards.
* Oversee inventory management of event supplies and materials across locations.

**Preferred Skills \& Certifications:**

* Certification such as CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) or CFM (Certified Facility Manager).
* Experience in global event coordination across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with ESG and sustainable event planning principles.
* Experience working in an IT Services or technology consulting organization.
* Knowledge of procurement and contract management systems.
* Experience supporting executive\-level events.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking
* Operational Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Presence
* Financial Acumen
* Risk Management
* Vendor Negotiation
* Project Management
* Communication \& Influence
* Problem Solving \& Agility
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Customer/Employee Experience Focus

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, Facilities Management, or related field.
* 14\-16\+ years of experience in corporate event planning within a technology or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting workplace, facilities, or corporate services functions.
* Strong budget management and vendor negotiation experience.
* Experience managing hybrid and virtual event environments.
* Knowledge of workplace operations and corporate real estate environments.
* Proficiency with event management software and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.

title: Workplace Associate Manager
description:
**Job Title**: Workplace Facility Management Associate Manager

**Management Level**: CL – 8 (Associate Manager)

**Work Location**: Jaipur

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

 **Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

**Department**:Accenture Workplace Solutions, Corporate Functions

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly /quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads, CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.
* Good knowledge of ISO standards like ISO45K, ISO27001, ISO14K, ISO22301\.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor.
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills:**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word, working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of Jaipur offices.

  

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft office, Power BI

**Experience**: Min 12 \- 15 years of experience in Facility management and administration with IT/ITES Sectors.

title: HR & Facilities Administrator
description:
**HR \& Facilities Administrator**

**Location:** Bangalore, India (In\-Office, HSR Layout)

**About AiPrise**  

AiPrise is a YC\-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross\-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world.  

  

Through a single integration, we connect 800\+ data sources and 80\+ verification partners across 200\+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge.  

  

Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount.  

  

We're \~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day.  

  

Borders shouldn't be blockers.

**About the Role**


We’re looking for a motivated and organized HR \& Facilities Administrator to be the operational lead of our Bangalore office. This is a hands\-on, in\-office role where you’ll ensure the workspace is running smoothly, new hires feel welcomed from day one, and our team has everything they need to do their best work. You’ll also partner with hiring managers to support recruiting and hiring efforts locally. You’ll work closely with our HR Manager in the US and serve as the primary point of contact for all things office, people operations, and recruiting in Bangalore.

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**HR \& People Operations**

* Own the onboarding experience for all new Bangalore\-based hires from pre\-day\-one setup to their first week in the office
* Coordinate with the US HR team to ensure new employees are set up in Rippling and have access to all necessary tools and systems
* Prepare and distribute onboarding materials, office access, and equipment for new joiners
* Serve as the local go\-to for day\-to\-day employee questions related to HR policies, office logistics, and benefits
* Support HR initiatives driven by the US team, including mid\-year reviews, culture programming, and compliance requirements
* Maintain accurate records related to local headcount, office inventory, and vendor contracts

**Office \& Facilities Management**

* Serve as the primary liaison with building management for all facilities\-related needs, including maintenance, repairs, access, and vendor coordination
* Ensure the office is consistently stocked with supplies, snacks, equipment, and anything the team needs to work comfortably
* Manage relationships with office vendors (cleaning services, pantry suppliers, courier services, etc.) and track related expenses
* Oversee the general upkeep, cleanliness, and organization of the office space
* Coordinate office\-related logistics for team events, offsites, or visiting employees from the US

**Recruiting \& Hiring Support**

* Partner with Bangalore\-based hiring managers to coordinate and move candidates through the interview process
* Schedule interviews, manage candidate communications, and ensure a smooth, timely hiring experience
* Maintain up\-to\-date candidate records and pipeline activity in Ashby (our ATS)
* Support job postings, offer letter preparation, and pre\-boarding logistics for new hires
* Serve as a local point of contact for candidates interviewing in person at the Bangalore office

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–3 years of experience in an office administration, HR coordinator, recruiting coordinator, or facilities management role
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills — you’ll work closely with a remote manager, local hiring managers, and candidates
* Proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset; you notice what needs to get done and take ownership
* Comfortable working with tools like Slack, Notion, and Google Workspace; experience with an ATS (e.g. Ashby) or HRIS (e.g. Rippling) is a plus
* Professional, warm, and approachable — people should feel comfortable coming to you with questions
* Prior experience supporting a startup or fast\-paced tech environment is a bonus

**Why AiPrise**

* Be a founding member of a growing Bangalore office with real impact on how it takes shape
* Work cross\-functionally with a global team and gain exposure to People Ops, recruiting, and startup operations
* Competitive compensation and benefits
* A culture that values “Global First” and “Build Fast, Ship Thoughtfully”

*AiPrise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team.*

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Overview:

ICIMS is seeking a Financial Analyst to join our FP\&A team. This is an excellent opportunity for a dynamic and highly analytical finance professional to help propel the business forward through data\-driven forecasts and impactful insights. In this role, you will drive continuous improvement and automation in financial and operational reporting, budget analysis, and approval workflows through Adaptive Insights and NetSuite. You will also play a key role in forecasting, the annual operating plan, and analyses supporting growth objectives. This role reports to the Sr. Manager, FP\&A and offers high visibility across finance and leadership teams. You will partner closely with cross\-functional teams across iCIMS, including Technology, Product Management, and G\&A, to support financial planning, analysis, and decision\-making.
About Us:

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. title: Office Manager - Associate
description:
**About the Role**  

iCapital is seeking an experienced and highly capable Office Manager to lead operations for our Jaipur office. This is a critical role within the global Facilities team and is central to delivering exceptional, consistent workplace experience for our employees as the company continues to grow.



Today, the Jaipur office spans four floors and supports approximately 115 employees. This office is expected to grow in scale and we need an office manager ready to assist in the office growth and grow with us. As a result, this role is expected to grow meaningfully in scope, responsibility, and team size. We are looking for a strong operator and people leader who can scale operations, build and manage a growing onsite team, and serve as a trusted partner to business leadership.



This position reports to the Regional Facilities Manager, based in New York.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Office Operations and Facilities Management**


* Lead all day\-to\-day operations to ensure the office is safe, clean, organized, and fully operational at all times.
* Own office services including supplies, pantry, snacks, beverages, and daily meal programs.
* Manage vendor relationships across cleaning, food and beverage, plant services, maintenance, deliveries, and other contracted services.
* Oversee office budgets related to operations, food, vendors, and events, including forecasting, invoice review, reconciliation, and expense tracking.
* Partner closely with Finance and Procurement teams to ensure strong financial controls and timely payments.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with building management and external partners, including insurance documentation and compliance requirements.
* Manage workplace service requests through OfficeSpace and ensure timely issue resolution.
* Support space planning, seating, and room usage across multiple floors using OfficeSpace.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries.
* Coordinate maintenance of office equipment and infrastructure, including electrical and HVAC systems, by managing vendors, AMCs, breakdowns, and timely issue resolution.

  


**Employee Experience and Hospitality**


* Create and maintain a professional, welcoming, and high\-quality office environment for employees, visitors, and candidates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, and IT on onboarding and offboarding logistics, including access, desk setup, and new hire readiness.
* Plan and execute internal events, employee engagement initiatives, and office wide celebrations, onsite and offsite to help employee retention and culture.
* Act as a visible, trusted, and approachable presence in the office, modeling service excellence and professionalism.
* Continuously evaluate and improve workplace programs to enhance employee satisfaction and operational efficiency.

  


**People Leadership and Growth**


* Directly manage and develop onsite facilities staff, with responsibility for hiring, training, and performance management as the team expands.
* Establish scalable processes, standards, and documentation to support long term growth.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to regional and global facilities leadership as the Jaipur office evolves.

  


**Office Relocation and Strategic Projects**


* Manage all phases of the move, including vendor coordination, space readiness, furniture and equipment setup, and post move stabilization as needed.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure a seamless transition into a new office.
* Support additional global and regional facilities initiatives as the business grows.

  


**Qualifications and Experience**


* Ability to work onsite Monday through Friday, 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM, with flexibility based on business needs.
* Fluency in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
* Demonstrated experience managing office operations in a fast paced, professional environment, ideally within a growing organization.
* Proven ability to manage vendors, budgets, and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience leading and developing teams, with the confidence and maturity to scale operations over time.
* Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organization.
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and integrity.
* Calm and composed under pressure, with strong problem\-solving instincts.
* Detail oriented, proactive, and highly accountable.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable adopting new workplace and facilities technology tools.

  



We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).

description:
Job DescriptionHR Operations \& Talent Manager

**Company:** ATZ Medappz Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** Branding Pioneers (Healthcare Marketing Agency)  
**Location:** Gurugram (Work from Office)

About Us

ATZ Medappz Pvt. Ltd. is the parent company of **Branding Pioneers**, one of India's growing healthcare marketing agencies. We work with hospitals, doctors, clinics and healthcare brands across digital marketing, websites, SEO, social media, branding and AI\-powered marketing solutions.

We are looking for an **execution\-first HR professional** who can build strong teams, maintain discipline and ensure high performance across the organization.

This is **not a traditional HR role**. Your success will be measured by the quality of people you hire, how productive the team becomes, and how quickly you solve people\-related problems.

What You'll Be DoingRecruitment \& Hiring

* Hire for marketing, design, SEO, websites, performance marketing, content, AI and operations roles.
* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment from sourcing to onboarding.
* Be comfortable with fast hiring whenever business requires it.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of quality candidates.
* Maintain relationships with recruiters, colleges and industry professionals.

Team Performance

* Check every employee's work regularly.
* Review deliverables before they reach clients.
* Conduct QA/QC across departments.
* Track daily, weekly and monthly KPIs.
* Identify poor performers early.
* Work with managers to improve employee performance.
* Create Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) wherever required.
* Recommend exits if performance does not improve.

Accountability

We need someone who is comfortable making difficult decisions.

You should be able to:

* Hold people accountable.
* Speak your mind respectfully.
* Challenge teams when standards are not being met.
* Work under pressure without compromising quality.
* Make hiring and separation decisions based on business needs.
* Avoid becoming emotionally attached while making professional decisions.

Marketing Understanding

You don't have to execute campaigns, but you must understand how marketing teams work.

A good understanding of the following is expected:

* SEO
* Website Development
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads
* Social Media Marketing
* Content Marketing
* Healthcare Marketing

This helps you hire the right people and evaluate their work effectively.

Employer Branding \& Internal Culture

* Create HR and company\-related social media content.
* Showcase company culture through videos and posts.
* Plan employee engagement activities.
* Organize team outings, celebrations and internal events.
* Build a workplace people enjoy while maintaining accountability.

Operations

* Conduct daily follow\-ups with teams.
* Maintain attendance and productivity reports.
* Ensure deadlines are met.
* Prepare weekly reports for leadership.
* Coordinate with department heads to improve team efficiency.

Preferred Background

We would strongly prefer candidates who have experience in one of the following:

* HR in a Digital Marketing Agency
* HR in a Healthcare Marketing Agency
* Healthcare professional transitioning into HR or Operations
* MBA (HR or Marketing)
* BBA \+ MBA
* Prior internships in recruitment, operations or agency environments

Candidates with an existing network of digital marketing professionals, especially those with healthcare marketing experience, will be given preference.

Skills Required

* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Strong decision\-making ability.
* Excellent observation and analytical skills.
* Confidence to have difficult conversations.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable using AI tools for hiring, reporting and productivity.

Who Should Not Apply

This role is **not** suitable if you:

* Avoid difficult conversations.
* Get emotionally affected while making professional decisions.
* Prefer slow\-paced environments.
* Are uncomfortable handling pressure.
* Cannot provide honest feedback.
* Are looking for a routine HR role focused only on documentation.

Selection Process

Candidates shortlisted for this position will go through:

* HR Interview
* Leadership Interview
* Practical Assignment
* Communication Assessment
* Final Discussion

The practical assignment is designed to evaluate your decision\-making, hiring ability, communication skills and operational thinking before the final selection.

Why Join Us?

* Work directly with founders.
* Build teams for one of India's growing healthcare marketing agencies.
* High ownership and fast career growth.
* Learn recruitment, operations, marketing and AI together.
* Opportunity to build an HR function from the ground up.

description:
**PURPOSE AND SCOPE:**


Support the GMS Training Office in the implementation, administration, maintenance and further development of the global GMS training system, the related regulatory training process and the IT\-systems used for this purpose.  

Work on projects for the continuous improvement and maintenance of learning management (LMS) systems and electronic tools (e.g. ComplianceWire).


Management of tasks in the area of GMS training, in particular supporting and guiding local training administrators in the implementation, administration, maintenance of the global GMS training system.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


Support the execution of subsequent activities within the department Management Systems Controls \& Services (MaCoSe)/GMS Training Office within the Global Management System (GMS) and the related training process and systems:(Support) maintenance of the regulatory training process and MS implementation processes and associated tools.

* Support the establishment and maintenance of a global FME communication network for (local) experts on the GMS Training process (Training SMEs)
* Administration of the established regulatory Learning Management System (e.g. ComplianceWire) on global level.
* Support, guidance and training for local LMS administrators as required.
* Create and apply current and appropriate learning concepts for the respective target audiences to support training and implementation.
* Provide a regulatory training offer to standardize and support the implementation of necessary processes and regulatory requirements. In particular, this includes:
* Coordinating the qualification of regulatory key functions, such as Local Management System Representatives in consultation with the respective Corporate Management System Representative.
* Organizing a regular offer of (virtual) classroom training courses (e.g.,GMS Training Weeks, coordination of webinars by external service providers))
* Provision of a “Quality \& Regulatory” training catalog within the currently established platforms
* (e.g., Learning Management System, Intranet)
* Administration of the GMS training offer (e.g., training catalog, document templates, organization of training registrations, verification documentation, interface to internal and external service providers and to the German works council, coordination of trainers)
* Design and implementation of training courses, including the creation of suitable teaching materials
* Creation of interactive teaching materials (e\-learning) using suitable authoring tools (e.g. Articulate 360\), as required.
* Support the creation and maintenance of curricula and training matrices for own department
* Guide owners of curricula and training matrices in their creation and maintenance
* Administrative tasks in the current Learning Management System (e.g., creation and maintenance of curricula and training matrices, user groups, training courses)
* Guide GMS process owners and trainers in creating a training strategy and respective training matrices as well as review of submitted training strategies and process training matrices as part of change control of GMS documents.
* As part of the document change control process, perform training task related approvals.
* Support preparation and check of Local Implementation Requests (LIR) and associated Quality and Regulatory Implementation Support (QRIS), specifically with regards to training\-relevant aspects.
* (Support with) project work and system implementations in accordance with specific task assignments
* Preparation of analyses, (status) reports and presentations on the GMS processes for training and implementation (e.g., as input for the management review).
* Administration of electronic platforms used by the department for information sharing and document storage (e.g., MS\-Teams, MS\- SharePoint, Intranet).

Completed scientific, medical or technical education at a technical college or university

* In total at least 3 to 6 years working experience
* At least 3 years of professional experience in the field of medical devices / medical technology or pharmaceuticals
* Preferably work experience in a multinational company Good communication skills
* Good analytical skills
* Good conflict management skills, proactive and solution\-oriented approach, openness to new tasks
* Basic Understanding of applicable normative and legal requirements for the medical device/pharmaceutical industry
* Basic Understanding of the applicable normative requirements that are the basis for FME certifications and management systems (e.g., ISO 13485, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, GxP, MDSAP)

* Good knowledge of written and spoken English

title: Specialist Assistant Manager - Talent Business Analyst (Consulting) - Hyderabad
description:
**Specialist Assistant Manager, Analytics and Insights (Consulting Services – Supporting US)**


At Deloitte, the Business Advisor team partners with the business leaders of a function or service to craft, execute and drive the delivery of the firm’s Talent strategy. You will play a key role in helping the business drive performance, develop talent and retain key talent. This role will focus primarily on RRWB support, with additional activities related to supporting the Talent life cycle processes in the business. You are expected to work with the business to drive solutions to core business problems from a Talent standpoint.

**Work you'll do**


As a Specialist Assistant Manager, Analytics and Insights (Consulting Services – Supporting US) on the Business Advisory team, you will be responsible for supporting business leaders with talent insights, workforce planning, and talent strategy execution.

* Support the annual compensation cycle by inputting and updating data, preparing reports, maintaining trackers, validating data, and coordinating process activities to help ensure timely and accurate completion of compensation planning deliverables.
* Support execution of targeted compensation activities, including off\-cycle adjustments, Reward Excellence processes, and associated reporting, tracking, coordination, and follow\-up activities.
* Collaborate with the compensation team and business partners to gather inputs and support consistent execution of compensation and talent\-related activities, including ad hoc support for talent processes.
* Analyze attrition, engagement, survey, and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, and actions that support business priorities.
* Evaluate talent programs and processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support implementation of new initiatives and cross\-functional projects.
* Develop reports, metrics, and insights to support headcount forecasting, skill planning, and talent decisions across assigned FSS groups.

**The team**


Our Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. It is structured into five major organizations: Talent Acquisition, Talent Delivery, Talent Development, Talent Specialties and Talent Operations.


As part of the Business Advisory team, you will work with our business leaders, foster change throughout the organization and ensure that Talent strategies are aligned with the firm’s culture.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM**

**Qualifications**


Required:

* MBA or equivalent degree
* 6\-9 years of experience in human resources, talent advisory, workforce planning, talent analytics, or human resources business partnering
* Experience analyzing workforce, attrition, engagement, or survey data using reporting or analytics tools
* Experience supporting business leaders in a matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Total Rewards, or Deployment stakeholders


Preferred:

* Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM), Professional in Human Resources (PHR), or Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR) certification
* Experience supporting performance management, succession planning, compensation planning, or workforce planning activities
* Experience creating executive\-ready dashboards, reports, or presentations
* Experience leading process improvement or cross\-functional initiatives
* Experience supporting US stakeholders or global teams


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Sr. HR Executive
description:
**About Us**

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing 360\-degree branding, web, and digital marketing agency working with diverse clients across industries. We are building a high\-performance culture driven by speed, ownership, innovation, and execution excellence. We are looking for an ambitious HR Executive who wants to grow aggressively along with the organization and contribute beyond traditional HR responsibilities.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly driven, hardworking, and execution\-focused **Human Resource Executive** who thrives in a fast\-paced and demanding work environment. This role is ideal for someone who believes in ownership, discipline, accountability, and continuous growth.

The ideal candidate should not only manage HR functions but also actively support **administration, operations, workforce planning, strategic growth initiatives, and multi\-location expansion plans** of the company.

We are seeking someone who is a **task finisher**, highly dependable, multi\-tasking, solution\-oriented, and capable of ensuring every critical task assigned by management is executed with precision and commitment.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Human Resource Management

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition across multiple departments.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, onboarding, induction, and employee documentation.
* Maintain employee records, HR policies, attendance, leaves, payroll coordination, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure smooth employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Build strong employee engagement and retention strategies.

2\. Administration \& Operations

* Oversee day\-to\-day office administration and operational coordination.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth workflow and resource allocation.
* Support process implementation and SOP adherence across departments.
* Ensure discipline, productivity, and operational efficiency.

3\. Strategic Support \& Business Growth

* Assist management in organizational growth planning and workforce scaling.
* Support multi\-location expansion activities including office setup, staffing, and coordination.
* Participate in strategic discussions and execution planning.
* Convert management decisions into actionable execution plans.

4\. Leadership \& Execution Support

* Understand management vision and priorities deeply.
* Ensure timely execution of tasks assigned by leadership.
* Track task progress and drive closure without constant follow\-up.
* Work proactively to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

**Candidate Requirements**

We are specifically looking for candidates who possess the following mindset and qualities:

* Be the right of the founder in scaling the organization
* Strong hunger for **fast career growth**
* Wants to grow with the company long\-term
* Extremely hardworking and committed
* Strong ownership mentality
* Execution\-focused with “task completion” attitude
* High level of dedication and discipline
* Ability to handle pressure and deadlines
* Excellent multi\-tasking abilities
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Solution\-oriented and proactive thinker
* Flexible mindset with startup\-like attitude
* Comfortable taking additional responsibilities beyond defined roles
* Growth mindset who are available in the office till the directors are there for the extended work hours

**Ideal Personality Traits**

We prefer candidates who are:

* Self\-driven and ambitious
* Loyal and trustworthy
* Energetic and highly responsible
* Fast learner with adaptability
* Process\-oriented yet action\-driven
* Comfortable in a high\-growth environment

**Work Culture Expectations**

This role is for someone who understands that **high growth requires high commitment**.

We expect the candidate to:

* Be available for extended working hours whenever business demands arise

title: Machine Learning Senior Analyst - HIH - Evernorth
description:
**Position Overview**


Are you looking for an opportunity to engineer modern application, Continuous Deployment/Continuous Integration, and embedded solutions(UI/API \& LLM) across a breadth of core platforms and technologies and foster a community while being supported with plentiful training and mentorship opportunities?


We’re looking for a Software Engineering Analyst who will be responsible to accelerate us on embedded solution(UI/API \& LLM) journey. The journey requires building foundational capabilities/patterns and enabling teams from a design, technical architecture and selecting LLM/cloud services wisely. This role requires proved technology excellence with strong hands\-on digital experience.


We are seeking a skilled and passionate Agentic AI Developer with 3–6 years of experience to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals who bring a fresh foundation in full stack development and have evolved into AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI domains. You will be instrumental in developing and deploying intelligent systems that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic architectures to solve complex business problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Gathers and analyzes test software requirements for various applications within the organization.
* Understands a program’s architecture/design, logical and physical data models.
* Design and Develop applications built in Python/C\#
* Good exposure on AI Concepts/Models (LLM)
* Support other product delivery partners in the successful build, test, and release of solutions
* Ability to work on projects independently with minimal or no oversight required.
* Examine and discover methods to improve the accuracy, effectiveness, and dependability of data quality and support.
* Support the full software lifecycle of design, development, testing, and support for technical delivery
* Works with both (Scrum Master, Product, QA and Developers) and QA team members in properly defining testable scenarios based on requirements/acceptance criteria.
* Be part of a fast\-moving team, working with the latest tools and open\-source technologies
* Work on a development team using agile methodologies.
* Understand the Business and the Application Architecture End to End
* Solve problems by crafting software solutions using maintainable and modular code
* Participate in daily team standup meetings where you'll give and receive updates on the current backlog and challenges.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science or Engineering or related course work
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in programming, API development and UI development. We need a very clear understanding \& be able to explain how would we develop sample cases.
* Basic hands on experience working in database environments like, Oracle, SQL, MongoDB etc
* Basic exposure in using IDE like Visual Studio Code, VS Code Etc
* Good hands on experience in Python, C\#. We need some passionate young developers to work on key initiatives which are aimed at accuracy \& efficiency.
* Design, fine\-tune, and deploy LLMs for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate LLMs with legacy systems and modern cloud\-native applications.
* Develop and optimize ML models for classification, prediction, and recommendation tasks.
* Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize models in production environments.
* Contribute to front\-end and back\-end development using Vue.js, Node.js, C\#, and .NET Core.
* Work with AWS services for scalable deployment of AI/ML solutions.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with advancements in GenAI, agentic frameworks, and cloud\-native AI tooling.

**Required Experience \& Education:**

* Proven hands on experience with design, and development of large\-scale enterprise application solutions.
* College degree (Bachelor) in related technical/business areas or equivalent work experience.
* Beginner level experience in relational and NOSQL databases
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in Software engineering
* Should be flexible in working with freshers and help them guide through the programme while they learn from senior resources in project.
* Hands on experience in developing applications in Python, C\# and machine learning concepts.
* Willing to learn, go above and beyond attitudes.
* Experience with modern and legacy development languages.

**Location \& Hours of Work**

* Full\-time position, working 40 hours per week. Expected overlap with US hours as appropriate
* Primarily based in the Innovation Hub in Hyderabad, India in a hybrid working model (3 days WFO and 2 days WAH)

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization\-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

**About Evernorth Health Services**


Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: CADD Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented CADD Engineer to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for creating, modifying, and maintaining 2D and 3D engineering drawings using CAD software while ensuring compliance with project specifications, company standards, and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

\* Prepare and modify 2D and 3D engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other CAD software.  
\* Develop detailed drawings, layouts, plans, sections, and elevations based on engineering inputs.  
\* Review drawings for accuracy, quality, and compliance with project standards.  
\* Coordinate with design engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to incorporate design changes.  
\* Maintain drawing revisions, document control, and version history.  
\* Ensure timely completion of assigned drafting tasks.  
\* Assist in preparing Bills of Materials (BOM) and other engineering documentation.  
\* Follow company drafting standards and industry best practices.  
\* Support project teams throughout the design and execution phases.

Required Skills

\* Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D \& 3D).  
\* Basic knowledge of engineering drawing standards.  
\* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.  
\* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.  
\* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.  
\* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.  
\* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

\* Knowledge of SolidWorks, Revit, MicroStation, or other CAD software is an added advantage.  
\* Understanding of engineering design principles and drafting standards.  
\* Familiarity with document management systems is preferred.

Qualifications

\* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.  
\* Freshers and candidates with up to 5 years of experience are welcome to apply.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AutoCAD Designer
description:

**Opus Innovation Private Limited** is a leading stainless steel fabrication company specializing in the manufacturing of premium commercial kitchen equipment for hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, hospitals, industrial canteens, bakeries, and institutional kitchens. title: CCTV Engineer
description:

VISHAL DIGITAL is a pioneer in IT solutions for the Media, Movie, and Broadcast industry. Established in 2012, the company provides advanced technology solutions including system integration, broadcast consultancy, and IT infrastructure services.

We are looking for a **CCTV technician** responsible for installation, configuration, and maintenance of CCTV surveillance systems and related security equipment.

* Freshers with technical knowledge can also apply.

**Apply:** manisha@ vishaldigital.com

title: Account Executive
description:
**Account Executive — Zalon (Z Revolution Tech Pvt Ltd)**  
Gurugram \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site

**About Zalon**

Zalon is India's digital distribution platform for the beauty \& salon industry — connecting professional brands with salons across the country. We move fast, work lean, and expect everyone on the team to own their work.

**What You'll Do**

* Day\-to\-day accounting entries — purchases, sales, expenses, payments — accurately and on time
* GST return filing (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B) and reconciliation with purchase data
* TDS deduction, deposit, and quarterly return filing (Form 24Q, 26Q)
* Bank reconciliation on a weekly basis — no backlogs, no surprises
* Accounts payable \& receivable — vendor bills, customer invoices, payment follow\-ups
* Support monthly MIS reporting and assist with audit documentation when required
* Work closely with our Finance Lead and flag issues proactively — not after they've become problems

**What We're Looking For**

* B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter or equivalent
* 0–2 years of hands\-on accounting experience (freshers with strong basics welcome)
* Solid understanding of GST concepts, ITC, and TDS — not just "I've heard of it"
* Working knowledge of Tally, Zoho Books, or any accounting software
* Able to manage your own task list without being reminded daily
* Honest, detail\-oriented, and someone who takes ownership

**This Role Is NOT For You If**

* You need constant hand\-holding for every task
* You treat GST and TDS as "something to figure out later"
* You're looking for a slow\-paced 9\-to\-5 corporate setup

**What Zalon Offers**

* A real startup where your work matters from Day 1
* Exposure to end\-to\-end startup finance — GST, TDS, payroll, investor reporting
* We will teach you what we can — but we will not teach you accountability
* Competitive salary based on experience and capability

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Computer Operator
description:
#### **Job Description**

  

We are looking for **Computer Operators** to support the QA / documentation team at our WHO\-GMP certified manufacturing plant. The role mainly involves **data entry, record\-keeping, and document issuance** under proper guidance. **Full training will be provided**, so it suits candidates who are good with computers and want a stable, long\-term job in pharma.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Data entry and maintenance of records in **MS Excel / Word** and company software.
* Issue and maintain controlled documents such as **logbooks, formats, and batch records (BMR/BPR)** as per instructions.
* Maintain **control sample records and registers** accurately.
* Keep proper filing of documents — both physical and digital — with correct numbering and tracking.
* Print, scan, photocopy, and manage documents as required.
* Update daily/weekly status and basic MIS reports.
* Follow **good documentation practices** and maintain confidentiality of company records.
* Coordinate with QA and other departments for document requirements and follow\-ups.

### **Requirements**

#### **Requirements**

* **Education:** 12th pass / Graduate (any stream).
* **Experience:** **Freshers welcome.** 0–2 years in computer operator / data entry / back\-office work.
* **Skills:**
	+ Good **typing speed** with accuracy.
	+ Working knowledge of **MS Excel, Word, and email**.
	+ Neat record\-keeping and strong attention to detail.
	+ Clear communication in **Hindi \& basic English**.
* **Personal Traits:**
	+ Disciplined, sincere, and reliable.
	+ Looking for a **long\-term, stable role**.
	+ Willing to learn and follow SOPs and instructions.

### **Benefits**

#### **Benefits**

* Salary as per industry norms
* **Full on\-the\-job training** in pharma documentation practices
* Health \& accidental insurance (self \& family), PF/ESIC as per norms
* Subsidised meals \& company transport
* Stable, long\-term career in a WHO\-GMP certified plant

title: Packing Officer
description:
#### **Job Description**

  

We are looking for **Packing Officers** to join the packing department at our WHO\-GMP certified manufacturing plant. This is a hands\-on role across our packing halls and packing material area. **Full training will be provided**, making it a good opportunity for science graduates who want to build a long\-term career in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

* Support day\-to\-day packing operations (blister, strip, bottle, and carton packing) as per the daily plan.

* Ensure correct material, **batch coding, and overprinting** details at the packing line.

	+ Sincere and looking for a **long\-term, stable role**.

* **Full on\-the\-job training** in GMP and packing operations
* Health \& accidental insurance (self \& family), PF/ESIC as per norms
* Subsidised meals \& company transport
* Stable, long\-term career growth in a WHO\-GMP certified plant

**Job Title:** Sales Development Representative Intern

**Company:** Improx Technology Private Limited  
**Location:** Baner, Pune (Work from Office)  
**Job Type:** Internship (Full\-Time)  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹5,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate

About the Company

Improx Technology Private Limited is a growing IT and IT\-enabled services company serving clients across North America and Europe. We specialize in Market Research, SaaS Solutions, Managed IT Services, Back Office Operations, Demand Generation, and Business Support Services.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Marketing Intern with an interest in **B2B Sales, SEO, and Lead Generation**. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, be comfortable with cold calling and client interactions, and have a basic understanding of SaaS products and IT services. This internship provides hands\-on exposure to international B2B marketing and sales strategies.

Key Responsibilities

B2B Sales \& Lead Generation

* Identify and research potential B2B clients through LinkedIn, company databases, online directories, and market research.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline by identifying decision\-makers across target industries.
* Support business development initiatives targeting North America and Europe.

Cold Calling \& Client Outreach

* Conduct outbound **cold calls** to prospective clients to introduce the company's IT, SaaS, and business solutions.
* Engage with decision\-makers to understand their business requirements and identify sales opportunities.
* Schedule meetings, product demonstrations, and discovery calls for the Business Development team.
* Follow up with prospects through calls, emails, and LinkedIn to nurture leads throughout the sales cycle.

Email Marketing \& Social Media Outreach

* Effectively communicate the company's value proposition during client interactions.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies.

Market Research

* Analyze customer needs, industry trends, and market demand to support marketing and sales strategies.
* Prepare reports and presentations based on research findings.

Events \& Conferences

* Content Marketing \& Brand Promotion

* Email Marketing \& LinkedIn Outreach

* Exposure to International Business Markets

* Opportunity to work with experienced professionals
* Potential full\-time employment opportunity based on performance

title: Back Office Admin
description:
Job Description: Back Office Admin Role Overview

​We are looking for a disciplined, detail\-oriented **Back Office Administrator** to support our core operations from behind the scenes. title: Urgently Looking for TPA Executive
company: Patiala Heart Institute and Multispeciality Hospital
description:
**Job Description – TPA Executive (Hospital)**

**Job Title:**

**TPA Executive (Third Party Administrator Executive)**

**Department:**

TPA / Insurance Department

**Reports To:**

TPA Manager / Billing Manager / Hospital Administrator

**Job Summary:**

The TPA Executive is responsible for coordinating cashless hospitalization services with insurance companies, TPAs, government health schemes, and corporate clients. The role involves obtaining pre\-authorizations, maintaining accurate documentation, processing claims, ensuring timely approvals, and providing excellent support to patients throughout the admission and discharge process.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Cashless Authorization**

* Process cashless hospitalization requests with TPAs and insurance companies.
* Submit pre\-authorization requests with complete medical documentation.
* Follow up with TPAs for timely approvals and query resolution.
* Inform patients and attendants regarding authorization status.

**2\. Documentation \& Claim Processing**

* Verify patient insurance cards, ID proofs, and policy details.
* Collect and maintain complete claim documents.
* Prepare and submit final claim documents after patient discharge.
* Ensure documentation complies with TPA and insurance guidelines.

**3\. Coordination**

* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, and medical records departments.
* Liaise with insurance companies, TPAs, corporate clients, and government health schemes such as ECHS, ESI, CGHS, Ayushman Bharat (PM\-JAY), and state health schemes.
* Resolve patient and insurer queries promptly.

**4\. Billing \& Settlement**

* Verify hospital bills before claim submission.
* Ensure approved amounts are accurately reflected in patient billing.
* Coordinate with the finance department for claim reconciliation.
* Assist in resolving claim deductions and rejections.

**5\. Patient Assistance**

* Explain cashless admission and discharge procedures.
* Guide patients regarding required documents and approvals.
* Ensure a smooth patient experience during hospitalization.

**6\. Record Maintenance**

* Maintain daily records of admissions, approvals, pending cases, discharges, and claim status.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Keep records updated in the Hospital Information System (HIS).

**7\. Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with hospital policies and insurance guidelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient records and insurance information.
* Support internal and external audits related to TPA claims.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc., BA, etc.)
* Preferred: MBA (Hospital Administration), MHA, BHA, or PG Diploma in Hospital Administration.

**Experience**

* **1–3 years** of experience in Hospital TPA, Medical Insurance, or Billing Department.
* Freshers with relevant hospital internship/training may also be considered.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of TPA and insurance claim processing.
* Experience with ECHS, ESI, CGHS, Ayushman Bharat (PM\-JAY), and private insurance claims.
* Familiarity with Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and Microsoft Office.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong documentation and record\-keeping abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Problem\-solving and coordination skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely submission of pre\-authorizations.
* Cashless approval turnaround time.
* Claim acceptance rate.
* Reduction in claim rejections and deductions.
* Timely submission of final bills and claim documents.
* Patient satisfaction score.
* Accuracy of documentation.
* Compliance with TAT (Turnaround Time).

**Working Conditions**

* Hospital environment.
* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays if required.
* Frequent interaction with patients, insurance representatives, doctors, and hospital staff.

This job description is suitable for multispecialty hospitals handling **private insurance, ECHS, ESI, CGHS, Ayushman Bharat (PM\-JAY), and corporate cashless patients**.

Pay: ₹15,075\.81 \- ₹24,509\.61 per month

**Position Details**

**Position:** UI/UX Designer Intern

**Internship Duration:** **6 Months**

**Internship Type:** Full\-Time Internship

**Location:** Dwarka, New Delhi

**Required Skills**

* **Figma (Mandatory)**
* Wireframing \& User Flow Design
* High\-Fidelity UI Design
* Responsive Mobile \& Web Design
* Auto Layout \& Components
* Design Systems
* Interactive Prototyping
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Photoshop
* Good understanding of Typography, Color Theory, Spacing, and Layout Design
* Basic understanding of UX principles and developer handoff

**Job Description**

As a **UI/UX Designer Intern**, you will work closely with our Product and Development teams to design intuitive, modern, and user\-friendly interfaces for our mobile and web applications. You will be involved throughout the design process—from understanding user requirements and creating wireframes to designing high\-fidelity interfaces and interactive prototypes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design modern and user\-friendly interfaces for mobile and web applications.
* Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI screens.
