* Create interactive prototypes for product demonstrations and usability testing.
* Design responsive layouts for multiple screen sizes.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Prepare design assets, icons, illustrations, and graphics for development.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas to improve the user experience.
* Maintain consistency across the entire product using design systems and UI standards.

**Important Company Policies**

* This is a **100% Work From Office (WFO)** internship. Remote or Hybrid work is **not available**.
* **Preference will be given to candidates residing within 10–15 km of Dwarka, New Delhi.** Candidates living farther away may apply only if they are willing to relocate near the office before joining.
* Candidates should be willing to work additional hours whenever required during project deadlines.
* All interns must sign a **Non\-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)**. All designs, prototypes, assets, and intellectual property created during the internship will remain the exclusive property of the company.
* Candidates are expected to complete the **entire 6\-month internship**. Leaving the internship before completion may result in the forfeiture of the internship benefits and certificate.

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands\-on experience working on a live startup product.
* Exposure to real\-world Mobile \& Web UI/UX Design.
* Experience in building scalable Design Systems.
* Collaboration with Product Managers and Developers.
* Opportunity to build a strong professional portfolio.
* Mentorship from experienced professionals.
* Potential full\-time opportunity based on performance.

**Mode:** Strictly In\-Person

**Interview Time:** **12:00 PM – 2:00 PM**

**Please Bring:**

* Updated Resume
* Portfolio (Figma, Behance, Dribbble, or PDF)
* Laptop (Preferred)
* Valid ID Proof

**Why Join Mindware?**

* Work on a real\-world product from day one.
* Learn in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Build your portfolio with production\-level UI/UX projects.
* Work alongside experienced developers and product teams.
* Performance\-based growth with the possibility of a full\-time role after successful completion of the internship.

**Interested candidates can directly walk in to our office with their updated resume and portfolio during the scheduled interview timings.**

The candidate will use Zoho Desk, Zoho CRM, and other Zoho One systems to manage service requests, customer communication, technician coordination, planned installations, and case closures.

Most workflows, reminders, task creation, and reports are system\-driven or automated. The role requires accurate system updates, timely follow\-up, and ownership of cases rather than extensive manual reporting.

**Zoho Desk and CRM Management**

* Understand common assembly, alignment, electrical, mechanical, and spare\-part issues.
* Escalate complex cases to the Service Manager with complete and structured information.

**Spare\-Parts Coordination**

* Coordinate approved spare\-part requirements against service tickets.
* Follow up for spare picking, dispatch, delivery, and installation.
* Track faulty\-part returns and update spare usage in the system.
* Support the Service Manager in maintaining accurate spare\-part records.

**Preventive Maintenance and Service Follow\-Up**

* Coordinate scheduled preventive\-maintenance visits through system\-generated tasks.
* Follow up with customers and technicians for timely completion.
* Confirm customer satisfaction before closing the service case.

* Basic written and spoken English

* Strong follow\-up and task\-closure ability
* Basic mechanical or electrical understanding
* Comfortable using CRM, ticketing software, WhatsApp, email, and digital tools

* Willingness to learn gym equipment, installations, and spare partsSuitable Industry Backgrounds

This role will build target account lists, execute structured outbound sequences, engage decision makers across global markets, qualify opportunities, and book high\-quality meetings for the BD team. The SDR will ensure strong handovers, disciplined follow\-ups, high CRM hygiene, and continuous conversion improvement—enabling predictable global revenue outcomes. 2\. 0\-1 years of experience in B2B Inside Sales/ SDR/ Lead Generation focused on international markets (engineering/ industrial/ B2B services preferred).

3\. Excellent written and spoken English with strong email/LinkedIn copywriting and professional communication standards.

4\. Proven outbound capability\- running multi\-touch sequences, handling objections, and executing disciplined follow\-ups.

6\. Comfortable working with time\-zone overlaps (US/ EU) and operating in a metrics\-driven cadence.

description:
**Summary**
 As an Business Analyst \- Content \& Document Management (Infra) at Gainwell, you can contribute your skills as we harness the power of technology to help our clients improve the health and well\-being of the members they serve — a community’s most vulnerable. Connect your passion with purpose, teaming with people who thrive on finding innovative solutions to some of healthcare’s biggest challenges. This role is strictly involved in business analysis, requirements documentation, and healthcare reference data support activities and does not involve direct access to Protected Health Information (PHI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), or any secured or confidential client data. The work is limited to analysis of healthcare claims, reference code sets, and system configurations using governed datasets and does not include handling or processing of sensitive health or personal information.
   

  

**Your role in our mission**
* This position will be responsible for supporting enterprise content and document management initiatives by performing a dual role as a Business Analyst and Data Analyst.
* The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, clients, and technical teams to gather requirements, analyze data, and map end‑to‑end solutions within the C3M, FileNet, and CMOD domain.
* The Business/Data Analyst will be responsible for eliciting and documenting business and functional requirements, validating change requests, and ensuring appropriate testing strategies and implementation plans are in place.
* This role requires strong analytical skills, deep domain understanding of document and content management systems, and the ability to audit solution changes to ensure quality, compliance, and operational readiness.
* The ideal candidate must be comfortable working with SQL for data analysis and validation, possess strong communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and high‑priority initiatives


**What We're Looking For**
* 6–9 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including writing complex queries for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements.
* Strong domain knowledge and hands‑on experience with C3M (Customer Communications Management), IBM FileNet, and IBM CMOD (Content Manager OnDemand).
* Ability to map business requirements to end products and technical solutions.
* Experience collaborating with technical teams to validate design, implementation, and delivery.
* Strong understanding of change management, including reviewing and auditing change requests for completeness, impact, and feasibility.
* Ability to assess and validate testing practices, ensuring adequate coverage and alignment with business requirements.
* Experience reviewing and validating implementation and deployment plans within the content management domain.
* Strong documentation skills, including preparation of BRDs, FRDs, data mappings, process flows, and use cases.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem‑solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience working in regulated or high‑volume document environments (banking, insurance, healthcare, government).
* Familiarity with document lifecycle management, archiving, and retention policies.
* Exposure to ETL or data integration concepts supporting content platforms.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of testing methodologies, including UAT planning and defect management.
* Ability to perform solution impact analysis and risk assessment.
* Strong ability to multitask and perform effectively in high‑pressure environments.


**What You Should Expect In This Role**
* Remote working environment with shift time 2pm \-11pm IST

 back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and,
   

  

 eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds,
   

  

 jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case
   

  

 outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation
   

  

 of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When
   

  

 someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came
   

  

 for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre —
   

  

 access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including
   

  

 Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Supervisor, RAFM
description:
Job Description


It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!  

  

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
  

  

**Risk , Fraud \& Compliance Officer**  

  

Regulated Industries \| Healthcare and Financial Crime
  

  

Reports to Sr. Manager, Risk and Fraud
  

  

Location: India. Onsite. Not eligible for remote work.
  

  

We are seeking a highly analytical and investigative professional to create compliance and risk actionable insights . This role monitors behavioral indicators, access activity, and operational anomalies to detect and prevent insider\-driven fraud, data misuse, and policy violations across a global environment.
  

  

What You'll do:  

  

  

* Identify insider behavioral risk and early\-warning indicators to detect fraud

  

* Use data to identify fraud rings, coaching fraud patterns, KPI manipulation, and payment diversion schemes

  

* Deliver actionable insights that strengthen controls and prevent incidents.

  

* Active assessment and monitoring of floor activities to identify behaviors or policy infractions

  

* Working with Sr. Site Leadership to identify, reduce and help resolve non\-compliance

  

**Position Summary**  

  

The Risk and Fraud Officer is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and reporting insider\-driven risks across the enterprise. This role monitors behavioral indicators, access patterns, data movement, and operational anomalies to detect early signs of fraud, misuse of systems, policy violations, or emerging threats. The Risk and Fraud Officer executes risk and fraud frameworks that identify, resolve, and prevent incidents before they escalate. This role partners closely with Global Risk \& Fraud Investigations, Compliance, IT Security, HR, and Operations leadership to ensure swift containment, root cause remediation, and long\-term control improvements.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Threat Detection , Analytics and Compliance**

title: Senior HR Partner, Corporate HR Partner Organization
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to identify process improvement opportunities and standardize best practices due to our extensive insights across business lines.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or 5\+ years of human resources experience and Bachelor's degree
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others
* Experience coaching managers and supervisors to use company best practices for maximum effectiveness
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* 
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative
* 
* Proven ability to successfully work as a team member and to build and maintain a positive work environment across the network


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.

title: Employee Relations Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Employee Relations Manager is responsible for fostering a positive work environment by managing employee relations programs, resolving workplace issues, and ensuring compliance with labor laws and company policies. This role serves as a trusted advisor to management and employees, promoting fairness, consistency, and engagement across the organization strengthening the compliance culture.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Employee Relations Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Investigate and lead the people\-related issues such as: behavior/conduct concerns, corrective actions for policy violations, employee grievances, and workplace conflicts in a timely and confidential manner.
* Liaise with labor offices and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and manage audits or inspections.
* Ensure adherence to labor laws, regulations, and internal HR policies.
* Provide guidance, in alignment with the HRBPs, to managers on addressing/resolving investigation outcomes, findings and recommendations, and related corrective and developmental actions.
* Review and update employee relations policies and procedures as needed.
* Partner with HRBPs to address complex employee relations cases, provide strategic solutions, embed compliance and ethical practices into organizational culture.
* Collaborate with global and regional Compliance, Ethics, and Legal teams to ensure alignment with corporate standards and regulatory frameworks.
* Analyze ER data, highlight key trends and provide insights that lead to the formulation of recommendations that drive positive employee relations programs and process improvements.
* Anchor / support the compliance awareness sessions \& training on policies, risk management practices, and other emerging or specific issues to promote consistent understanding across teams.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Masters Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Masters in Social Work (Full\-Time) in Human Resource Management.
* 8\+ years of experience in employee relations.
* Strong knowledge in Indian Labour laws and compliance requirements
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills .
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities .
* Demonstrated capability to drive outcomes through collaboration and persuasion.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Degree in Law is preferred.
* Ability to work in a highly matrix environment.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 Nil
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Type**

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition Manager leads the end\-to\-end recruitment function for IT By Design's India operations, owning the full hiring lifecycle across technical, non\-technical, and leadership roles. This role is responsible for building a high\-performing Talent Acquisition team, developing proactive sourcing strategies, and ensuring that every hire reflects the company's values, capability standards, and culture.
 



 Sitting at the intersection of HR strategy and business execution, the Talent Acquisition Manager partners closely with department heads, HR leadership, and senior management to forecast hiring needs, reduce time\-to\-fill, strengthen employer branding, and build talent pipelines that support IT By Design's continued growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the full\-cycle recruitment process for all roles in India, from requisition intake to offer rollout, ensuring a high\-quality candidate experience.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Talent Acquisition Partners and Sourcing Specialists by setting goals, reviewing performance, and driving accountability.
* Partner with business leaders and HR teams to forecast hiring demand, develop workforce plans, and create proactive hiring strategies.
* Develop and execute multi\-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Indeed, employee referrals, campus hiring, and passive talent mapping.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and high\-volume positions across technology, HR, marketing, finance, and operations functions.
* Define and implement structured interview processes, competency frameworks, and assessment methodologies to improve hiring quality.
* Own recruitment metrics including Time\-to\-Fill, Time\-to\-Offer, Source of Hire, Offer Acceptance Rate, and Cost per Hire, and present insights to leadership.
* Drive employer branding initiatives through LinkedIn, Glassdoor, campus engagement programs, and Great Place to Work activities.
* Manage and optimize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring process compliance, data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
* Oversee campus hiring programs, walk\-in drives, and lateral recruitment campaigns.
* Ensure all recruitment activities comply with organizational policies, budgets, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with global Talent Acquisition and HR teams across India, the Philippines, and the United States.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 8\-12 years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience with at least 2\-3 years in a managerial or team leadership role.
* Proven experience managing high\-volume and leadership hiring simultaneously within IT Services, Technology, SaaS, or related industries.
* Strong hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Indeed, and Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and manage Talent Acquisition teams.
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders on workforce planning and hiring strategy.
* Strong understanding of competency\-based interviewing and structured assessment methodologies.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills with experience in recruitment dashboards and KPI reporting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience hiring for US\-facing or global roles within Managed Services, IT Services, BPO, or SaaS organizations.
* Exposure to diversity hiring programs and inclusion initiatives.
* Experience with employer branding, Glassdoor strategy, and Great Place to Work programs.
* Familiarity with HRIS and HR technology platforms such as PeopleStrong, Darwinbox, or similar tools.
* Professional certifications in Talent Acquisition or Human Resources (SHRM, NHRDN, or equivalent).



  





**Behavioral Competencies:** 



* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for hiring outcomes.
* Proactive and strategic approach toward talent pipelining.
* Collaborative and consultative stakeholder management skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making capability.
* Strong focus on candidate experience and employer branding.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and during high\-volume hiring cycles.
* Passion for coaching and developing Talent Acquisition teams.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 First 30 Days:
 


* Complete assessment of current recruitment processes, hiring pipeline, team capability, and open positions.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and hiring managers.



 First 60 Days:
 


* Establish structured hiring processes and service level agreements.
* Improve ATS hygiene and activate sourcing channels for critical roles.



 First 90 Days:
 


* Demonstrate measurable reduction in hiring turnaround time.
* Improve hiring manager satisfaction.
* Establish performance goals and accountability mechanisms for the Talent Acquisition team.



 By 6 Months:
 


* Build talent pipelines for recurring and critical positions.
* Launch employer branding initiatives.
* Present monthly recruitment dashboards and insights to leadership.



 By 12 Months:
 


* Consistently achieve hiring SLAs.
* Strengthen Talent Acquisition team capability.
* Improve referral hiring and offer acceptance rates year\-over\-year.



  





**Who This Role Is For:** 



* Experienced Talent Acquisition leaders who want to own and build a recruitment function.
* Recruitment professionals who understand both the operational and strategic aspects of Talent Acquisition.
* Leaders who enjoy building processes, systems, and scalable hiring practices.
* Professionals passionate about candidate experience and employer branding.
* Individuals comfortable presenting hiring insights and analytics to senior leadership.



  





**Who This Role Is Not For:** 



* Individual contributors who are not interested in managing and developing teams.
* Recruiters focused only on volume hiring without emphasis on quality or process.
* Candidates uncomfortable with metrics, reporting, and accountability.
* Professionals seeking a purely operational recruitment role.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Strong work\-life balance.
* Medical insurance coverage up to INR 5 Lakhs for employees and immediate family members.
* Personal accident insurance coverage of INR 5 Lakhs.
* Term life insurance coverage of INR 20 Lakhs.
* Community engagement and employee clubs.
* Subsidized meals and discounted health check\-up programs.
* Employee wellness initiatives and wellbeing programs.
* CEO's personalized "Life by Design" program focused on holistic growth and fulfillment.



  





**About IT By Design:** 




 IT By Design is a people\-first technology services and staffing organization that bridges the talent gap between the US market and highly skilled professionals across India, the Philippines, and other global locations. We partner with MSPs, IT service providers, and technology companies to build teams that are technically strong and culturally aligned.
 



 We operate with a long\-term mindset, focusing not only on filling positions but also on building careers, enabling growth, and creating opportunities for both individuals and businesses. Our global delivery model combines operational excellence with a genuine commitment to people.
 



 If you are looking for an organization where your contribution is visible, your growth is intentional, and your work creates meaningful impact, IT By Design offers an exciting opportunity.

**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving complex business problems at scale through Generative AI? Do you want to help build intelligent systems that reason, act, and learn from minimal supervision? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you on Amazon's Trustworthy Shopping Experience (TSE) team.
   

  

 At TSE, our vision is to guarantee customers a worry\-free shopping experience by earning their trust that the products they buy are safe, authentic, and compliant with regulations and policy. We do this in close partnership with our selling partners, empowering them with best\-in\-class tools and expertise to offer a high\-quality, compliant selection that customers trust.
   

  

 As an Applied Scientist I, you will bring subject matter expertise in at least one relevant discipline (e.g., NLP, computer vision, representation learning, agentic architecture) to contribute to next\-generation agentic AI solutions that automate complex manual investigation processes at Amazon scale. Working alongside senior scientists, you will map business goals—such as reducing cost\-of\-serving while maintaining trust and safety standards—to well\-defined scientific problems and metrics. You will invent, refine, and experiment with solutions spanning agentic reasoning, self\-supervised representation learning, few\-shot adaptation, multimodal understanding, and model compression. With guidance from senior scientists, you will stay current on research trends and benchmark your results against the state of the art.
   

  

 You will help design and execute experiments to identify optimal solutions, initiating the development and implementation of small components with team guidance. title: AI Engineer: Agentic Systems & War Simulation
description:
***The goal is simple. Help India win the next war.***




 AlphaGo discovered moves in Go that no human had played in thousands of years of the game’s history. Moves that looked wrong to experts but proved devastatingly effective.
 



***We’re building the equivalent for air warfare.***




 A system where AI agents play through ten thousand conflict scenarios overnight, discover strategies that human planners would never consider, and stress\-test every plan against an adversary AI that actively tries to break it. India enters any conflict having already explored more of the strategic space than any human planning staff ever could. The war is fought in simulation a thousand times before it is fought once in reality, and the side that has done that preparation wins.
 



 This is not a simulation with better graphics. It is a tool that out\-thinks the adversary.
 



**What You’d Build** 




 You own the AI agent architecture. Someone else builds the simulation engine. You build the intelligence on top.
 


* Agents that reason about complex multi\-day, multi\-front operations and explore the strategy space at a scale no human planning staff can.
* Adversarial agents that find the weaknesses in any plan before the enemy does
* A learning loop where agents get meaningfully smarter over thousands of self\-play iterations.
* A reasoning layer that can explain to a military commander why a strategy works and where it breaks, with specific evidence



**The hard problems you’d spend your time on:** 



1. How do you represent the state of a complex, partially observable conflict so an agent can reason about it effectively?
2. How do you combine long\-horizon strategic planning with tactical adaptation?
3. How do you build a Red agent that is genuinely dangerous rather than a scripted opponent?
4. How do you make agent reasoning auditable and trustworthy enough that a commander acts on it?



**Why This Is Hard** 




 The action space is enormous. The environment is partially observable and stochastic. The adversary adapts. Planning horizons span days, not moves. A single decision (when to commit reserves, which front to prioritize) cascades in ways that only become visible much later.
 



 Standard approaches break in ways that are obvious once you understand the problem, but non\-obvious if you’re pattern\-matching from existing work. No standard playbook exists for this. You’d be designing the architecture from first principles.
 



**Who This Is For** 




 We don’t care about years of experience or seniority. We care about how you think.
 



 The bar is: can you design and build an agentic architecture that outcompetes systems built by teams ten times your size at companies with a hundred times your budget? If yes, the rest doesn’t matter.
 



**What we’re looking for:** 



* Exceptional first\-principles thinking. You derive architectures from the problem, not from what you’ve seen others do.
* Deep independence. You take an ambiguous, open\-ended problem and come back with a working system. No hand\-holding, no waiting for specs.
* Technical brilliance in at least one of: reinforcement learning, LLM agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, game AI. You don’t need to be broad. You need to be devastatingly good at the thing you’re good at.
* No defence background required. No specific tool or framework required.



***"If the idea of building an AlphaGo for warfare doesn’t make you want to drop everything, this isn’t for you. If it does, we’d like to talk."***

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




 AirBills is building a utility bill automation and cost optimisation platform for short\-term rental and single\-family rental property owners and managers.
 



  





 Utility billing is still a manual, messy and time\-consuming process for many property operators. AirBills helps customers connect utility accounts, monitor bills, automate payments, track usage, identify savings opportunities and reduce billing friction across growing property portfolios.
 



  





 The platform connects with thousands of utility providers and supports customers who manage everything from a few homes to large rental portfolios. We are building for a real operational problem, with a product that sits at the intersection of SaaS, automation, payments, data, property operations and cost optimisation.
 



  





 We are growing the team and building a strong team of people who want to help make utility billing simpler, smarter and more reliable.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a
 **Quality Assurance Automation Engineer** 
 to help AirBills ship faster while keeping the product reliable, accurate and trusted by customers.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys testing real user workflows, finding edge cases, improving automation coverage and working closely with engineering and product teams. You will help validate web applications, backend services, integrations, billing workflows, reports, alerts and customer\-facing product journeys.
 



  





 We are open to candidates from QA automation, SDET, software testing, manual QA with automation exposure, API testing, implementation testing, product support engineering or adjacent technical backgrounds.
 



  





 You do not need to come from the utility billing or property technology industry. What matters most is your ability to understand product workflows, think carefully about failure points, write clear test cases, automate repeatable checks and communicate issues in a way that helps the team move faster.
 



  





**What You’ll Work On** 



* Design, build and maintain automated tests for web applications, APIs and backend workflows
* Create clear test plans and test cases for product features, integrations and user journeys
* Perform manual exploratory testing where automation is not yet available or practical
* Test billing\-related workflows, account\-linking flows, reporting dashboards, alerts and operational edge cases
* Identify, document and communicate bugs with clear reproduction steps and expected behaviour
* Work with engineers to improve test coverage, release confidence and product reliability
* Support regression testing, release validation and quality checks before production releases
* Help improve QA processes, testing standards and automation practices as the product scales
* Contribute to CI/CD testing workflows and make testing more repeatable over time



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Experience in QA, software testing, QA automation, SDET, product testing or a similar role
* Hands\-on exposure to automated testing for web applications, APIs or product workflows
* Experience with tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Postman or similar testing frameworks
* Ability to write, maintain and review structured test cases, including positive, negative, regression and edge\-case scenarios
* Strong manual testing fundamentals and the ability to test complex user flows thoughtfully
* Comfort working with engineering, product and support teams in a remote environment
* Strong bug reporting, troubleshooting and written communication skills
* Good attention to detail and ownership of release quality
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities and follow through on testing commitments



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience testing SaaS, B2B platforms, fintech, proptech, payments, billing, workflow automation or operational software
* API testing experience using Postman or similar tools
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and troubleshooting
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Git, Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues or similar development tools
* Experience working with distributed or US\-based teams
* Exposure to usage tracking, billing workflows, account integrations, dashboards or alerting systems



  





**Who Should Apply** 




 You should apply if you have worked in QA automation, manual QA with automation exposure, SDET, API testing, implementation testing, product testing, technical support engineering or adjacent roles where you were responsible for validating software quality.
 



  





 We are especially interested in people who can combine structured QA thinking with practical product judgment. You should be comfortable asking, “What could break here?”, “What would confuse the user?”, and “How do we catch this before the customer does?”
 



  





 We know strong candidates may not match every point listed above. If this role feels close to your experience and you are excited about the work, we encourage you to apply.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 USD $85,000–$130,000 (Fixed\+ESOPs) annual equivalent, depending on experience, seniority and engagement model. For contract arrangements, equivalent hourly compensation may apply.
 



  





**Work Type** 




 Full\-time / Contract
 



 Remote, India

title: Penetration Tester
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Penetration Tester is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for assessing and evaluating the security posture of the company's information systems, networks, applications and infrastructure.
   

  

 This role involves conducting rigorous penetration testing and ethical hacking activities to identify vulnerabilities and potential weaknesses for exploitation.
   

  

 The Penetration Tester collaborates with cross functional teams and provides strategic security recommendations and assists in strengthening the company's overall cybersecurity defenses.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Plans, executes and manages complex penetration testing engagements on various IT assets, including networks, applications and databases.
* Conducts simulated cyber\-attacks, including social engineering, to identify vulnerabilities and assesses the organization's resilience to cyber threats.
* Performs penetration tests against internal and external facing systems.
* Analyses and interprets penetration test results and provides detailed reports to relevant stakeholders.
* Provides input to improve the quality and effectiveness of tests in a highly scaled and global environment.
* Articulates complex technical risks through creation of reports and delivering presentations to key stakeholders.
* Works with Security DevOps teams to test the orchestration and automation processes and platforms, feed results into a testing program.
* Supports the assessment risk and the development and/or recommends appropriate mitigation countermeasures based on empirical testing.
* Provides comprehensive technical expertise with web, application and database vulnerability testing.
* Supports the development of the security automation framework and the implementation roadmap.
* Provides actionable security recommendations and mitigation strategies to address identified vulnerabilities.
* Ensures that penetration testing activities align with relevant industry standards, compliance regulations, and best practices.
* Contributes to any security awareness training and education programs to promote a culture of cybersecurity within the organization.
* Stays up to date with the latest cybersecurity threats, attack vectors, and defensive technologies to continuously improve testing methodologies.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects within remote environment.
* Demonstrates a strong ability to engage with various stakeholders, have a team\-based approach and work towards share goals and outcomes.
* Ability to think outside the box and a passion to improve your skills and drive innovation.
* Ability to compromise systems and demonstrate ways to laterally move post compromise.
* In\-depth knowledge of common security assessment methodologies, such as OWASP, PTES, or NIST SP 800\-115\.
* Strong understanding of various operating systems, network protocols, and application security.
* Proficiency in using penetration testing tools and frameworks, such as Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, and Wireshark.
* Knowledge of security assessment tools and technologies used to evaluate web applications, databases, and network infrastructure.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify and exploit vulnerabilities effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to deliver clear and concise reports and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ethical and professional conduct with a commitment to confidentiality and data privacy.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computer Science or related field.
* Security related certifications such as OSWE, OSEP, OSCP, OSCE, CRTP, GPEN, or CREST is desirable.


**Required experience:**
* Seasoned demonstrated penetration testing experience and ethical hacking gained within a similar global environment.
* Seasoned demonstrated experience with both commercial and open\-source security tools and scripting languages.
* Seasoned demonstrated exposure to security testing scenarios e.g. Capture the Flag / Red Team / Blue Team is desirable.
* Seasoned demonstrated experience with various testing platforms e.g. Hack the Box / Vulnhub / PentesterLab is desirable.


**Workplace type:**
 Hybrid Working

 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.

Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**About Position**
 We are seeking for Network Engineer with hands on experience in Routing, Switching, Cloud Networking etc,.
   

  

* Role: Network Engineer
* Location: All Persistent Location
* Experience: 8\+ years
* Job Type: Full Time Employment


**What You'll Do**
* Design, implement, and operate enterprise LAN/WAN/WLAN and cloud\-connected networks.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, and network services (VLANs, STP, DHCP, DNS, NAT).
* Work on routing protocols and traffic engineering (BGP/OSPF), ensuring optimal paths and redundancy.
* Support cloud networking constructs such as VPC/VNet, subnets, gateways, load balancers, and connectivity (VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect).
* Monitor network performance, capacity, and availability; proactively address bottlenecks and failures.
* Implement and document network changes (CR/PR), standard operating procedures, and runbooks.
* Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to enforce segmentation and security best practices.
* Participate in on call/incident response, RCA, and continuous improvements.


**Expertise You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise networking (routing/switching) and network troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of routing (BGP/OSPF), redundancy (HSRP/VRRP), and L2/L3 design patterns.
* Exposure to firewall/VPN fundamentals and network security controls (ACLs, segmentation).
* Working knowledge of cloud networking (AWS/Azure/GCP) and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with network monitoring and logging tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Grafana, Zabbix or equivalents).
* Ability to produce clear documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
* Preferred: Automation exposure (Python/Ansible), SD\-WAN, load balancers, or CDN basics.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/computer science/IT or equivalent practical experience.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

**Job Description**
**The Team:**
 Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking a talented Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain secure and reliable network infrastructure. This role is crucial for ensuring seamless connectivity and optimal performance across our global operations.
   

  

**The Role**
* Design, configure, and deploy network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Monitor network performance, identify issues, and implement proactive solutions to ensure high availability and reliability.
* Troubleshoot complex network problems, including connectivity, performance, and security\-related incidents.
* Implement and maintain network security policies and procedures, including access control lists, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
* Perform regular network audits and assessments to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with other IT teams and business units to understand requirements and provide network solutions.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for network support and incident response.
* Evaluate and recommend new network technologies and solutions to improve efficiency and security.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience as a Network Engineer in an enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, MPLS, etc.) and network services (DNS, DHCP).
* Proficiency with Cisco networking equipment (routers, switches, firewalls) is essential.
* Experience with network security best practices and technologies (e.g., VPNs, firewalls, IDS/IPS).
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools and techniques.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, JNCIP) are highly desirable.
* Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

 How we look after you
   

  

 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.*

title: Engineer NPO
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Performance Optimization (NPO) Specialist, you will monitor and analyze network performance, identify and diagnose root causes of issues, and implement optimization actions such as QoS adjustments, parameter tuning, and software upgrades to ensure continuous performance.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead and serve as the primary contact for specific technical domains and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), managing project deliverables independently.
* Engage with customers as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), offering technical guidance and insights.
* Optimize network performance through traffic, capacity, and neighbor management to enhance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and end\-user experience.
* Identify and recommend new feature rollouts and conduct carrier aggregation analysis for multi\-carrier networks.
* Perform analysis and optimization for benchmarking activities (e.g., Umlaut/P3, regulatory drive tests) and validate/optimize Network Performance Optimization (NPO) tools.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., CM, PM, FM, OMS) to resolve issues and manage customer interactions regarding Service Level Agreement (SLA) KPIs, regulatory compliance, and benchmarking reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You Have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in or related field with experience in Network Performance Optimization.
* Expertise in radio optimization for the latest SW/HW Release of Nokia 5G/4G and/or Samsung/Huawei 5G /4G Network.
* Experience in OEM\-specific tools and products, including Nokia SRAN BTS, NetAct, and/or Samsung LSMR, USM.
* Experience in at least two RATs (5G \& 4G) per OEM.
* End\-to\-end correlation across Radio, Access, IP, Transport, and Core domains.to improve Customer Experience, Service KPIs.
* Experience in spectrum refarming, 2G/3G sunset strategies, and post\-optimization activities. Proficiency in data visualization \& reporting tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Pivot Tables, Power BI).
* Experience in Radio Network Consolidation, ORAN, Cloud RAN, VRAN, Enterprise Networks, Private 5G, Massive MIMO, Network Slicing, MEC, and IoT Connectivity.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Good understanding of Managed Services Processes. Good experience in delivering managed services projects for a multi\-vendor environment.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.  Overview:
   

  

 The Network Security Specialist is a critical role focused on securing our network infrastructure and ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our data. This position requires a strong understanding of networking principles and protocols, coupled with deep expertise in security best practices and threat mitigation. This includes a strong understanding of both Interior Gateway Protocols (IGPs) such as OSPF and Exterior Gateway Protocols (EGPs) such as BGP.
   

  

**Main Accountabilities** 
 (List 6\-8 major areas of responsibilities in order of importance, and purpose of these activities:
   

  

* Network Security Engineering: Design, Document, implement, and maintain security solutions for our network infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, and network access control (NAC) systems. This includes the secure configuration and hardening of routing protocols like OSPF and BGP.
* Security Monitoring \& Incident Response: Proactively monitor network traffic for suspicious activity, analyze security alerts, and conduct thorough investigations of security incidents to determine root cause and implement appropriate remediation measures. Develop and refine incident response playbooks, specifically addressing potential routing\-related security events.
* Vulnerability Management: Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of network devices and systems, including an in\-depth analysis of routing protocols like OSPF and BGP for potential vulnerabilities. Analyze results, prioritize remediation efforts, and work with IT teams to mitigate identified vulnerabilities.
* Security Policy \& Compliance: Contribute to the development and maintenance of network security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure network infrastructure and security controls adhere to industry best practices and regulatory requirements, including those related to routing security.
* Threat Intelligence: Stay abreast of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors. Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively implement countermeasures to protect the network from evolving threats, with specific attention to threats targeting routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Work closely with other IT teams, including system administrators, network engineers, and security analysts, to ensure the security of the overall IT environment. Effectively communicate security posture and findings to management and stakeholders, including explanations of complex routing security concepts.


**Impact/Dimensions** 
 (Describe the strategic impact of the role / Using dollars and/or numbers, list the pertinent statistics of the position which clarify major areas of impact. Examples are: \# of employees supervised, annual budget, annual sales/revenue):
   

  

* Directly responsible for the security posture of the organization's network infrastructure and data traversing it, including the security and integrity of routing protocols.
* Plays a crucial role in preventing data breaches, service disruptions, and reputational damage that could arise from compromised routing infrastructure.
* Contributes to regulatory compliance and maintaining customer trust by ensuring the secure operation of critical routing protocols.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 
 (Measurable outcomes that the position contributes to):
   

  

* Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) for security incidents, including those related to routing infrastructure.
* Number of vulnerabilities identified and remediated within defined SLAs, specifically addressing vulnerabilities in routing protocols and configurations.
* Network uptime and availability related to security incidents, including the ability to maintain routing availability during attacks or outages.
* Compliance with established security policies and industry best practices, particularly those related to routing security and configuration.


**Major Opportunities and Decisions** 
 (Describe the more difficult and/or complex challenges or opportunities and decisions faced in doing work, improving processes or meeting customer needs. Where must position focus to be successful?):
   

  

* Recommending and implementing new security technologies and solutions to enhance network security posture, including advanced routing security mechanisms.
* Architecting and implementing secure network designs and configurations, incorporating best practices for routing security and resilience.
* Developing and refining incident response plans and procedures, with a focus on identifying and responding to routing\-related security events.
* Providing expert guidance on complex security issues impacting network infrastructure, specifically addressing routing security challenges and solutions.


**Management/Leadership** 
 (Describe the level of management and leadership skills required for the role. Identify key specialties, technical and knowledge areas necessary to accomplish responsibilities and desired results):
   

  

* May mentor and provide technical guidance to junior security analysts, particularly in the area of routing security.
* Act as a subject matter expert for network security within the organization, providing in\-depth knowledge and guidance on routing protocols and their security implications.


**Key Relationships, Stakeholders \& Interfaces** 
 (External \& Internal):
   

  

* Internal: IT operations, security operations center (SOC), system administrators, network engineers, application owners, with a focus on collaborating on routing security issues.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to help own Creative AI — a product that takes a brand and turns out finished ad creative (images, resizes, videos, reels, UGC) that actually looks on\-brand rather than generic AI output. A lot of it is already live and producing real client work, but it is a deep, fiddly product with many models working behind the scenes, and today most of it runs through a small number of people. We need someone to get into the weeds: write the specs, review the real output with a critical eye, catch what is broken, and help push the roadmap from "powerful but hand\-held" toward something a marketer or our creative team can run smoothly every day.
 



 This is a genuine hands\-on, learn\-by\-doing role. You will not be handed a finished playbook — you will help write one. It is ideal for someone early in their product career with strong taste, attention to detail, clear writing, and real curiosity about where AI creative is heading.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Write clear specs, user stories, and tickets that turn fuzzy ideas into work an engineer can build without a dozen follow\-up questions
* Review creative output with a critical eye — running new features and fixes through their paces, catching garbled text, off\-brand colours, and broken layouts, and writing up exactly what is wrong with examples
* Observe the creative team and clients using the tool to find where it slows them down, and turn those frictions into prioritised fixes
* Support the product roadmap by keeping the backlog groomed and honest, tracking what is shipping against the plan, and flagging slips and mismatches with real customer needs
* Drive recurring customer asks (PSD and open\-file support, push\-to\-platform, better voiceovers, quick\-commerce formats) from a vague wishlist into scoped, prioritised work
* Coordinate across engineering, the creative team, and the senior PM — keeping everyone pointed at the same thing and unblocking small issues before they grow
* Document how the model\-heavy pipeline and features work, so product knowledge stops living only in a couple of engineers' heads



  





 Required Prerequisites
 


* 2\-4 years of experience — a strong recent graduate, someone moving into product from design, marketing, or a creative or analyst background, or an early\-career PM looking to go deep on an AI product
* A demonstrable eye for visual and creative quality — you notice when something looks off (kerning, a slightly wrong logo, a layout that does not breathe)
* Strong written communication, with the ability to make fuzzy things concrete in specs, bug reports, and summaries
* Genuine curiosity about AI products and how generation pipelines and models work, even without a coding background
* Strong organisation and follow\-through, with a habit of turning chaos into a tidy list and closing things out
* Comfort with ambiguity and speed in an early, fast\-changing product



  





 Core Competencies \& Skills
 


* Strong attention to detail and quality judgment, which matters more than almost anything on a creative product
* Practical familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or similar for research, documentation, and prototyping
* Clear written communication for specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and bug reports
* Ability to simplify complex AI outputs and multi\-step pipelines into clear, understandable user experiences
* Customer\-first working style with comfort joining demos, onboarding calls, and feedback sessions
* Basic technical fluency — enough to understand why a pipeline has multiple steps and what each model is doing
* Practical judgment around AI products, including reliability, quality checks, approval flows, and usage cost
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup with changing priorities and early\-stage product assumptions
* Nice to have: a background or strong interest in design, advertising, or marketing; hands\-on experience with creative tools (Figma, Canva, Photoshop, or AI tools like Midjourney, Runway, or Kling); and a side project, design, or campaign that shows you can take an idea to done

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Company Overview:** 




 Frevolt (web: www.frevolt.co) is a tech\-enabled residential solar company on a mission to make rooftop solar simple, transparent, and accessible for homeowners across Maharashtra. We install solar rooftop systems in Sangli, Pune, and Nashik — and we build the software that powers every step of that journey, from the very first quote to long\-term system performance. Our products serve both our customers and internal teams who deliver for them.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own the product experience across Frevolt's customer\-facing and internal applications. This is a hands\-on, end\-to\-end role: you will move from understanding a problem, to coordinating with the team that builds and ships the solution, to measuring its impact.
 



 You will report to the Product Manager and work directly with the founding team and engineering. That means high ownership, high visibility, and the chance to see your decisions reach real users quickly. If you want breadth, autonomy, and a front\-row seat at an early\-stage climate\-tech company, this role is built for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own:** 




 ● Product discovery — talk to customers, sales teams, and operations staff to uncover real problems, then translate them into clear, prioritized opportunities.
 



 ● Write crisp, unambiguous Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) covering user flows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
 



 ● Coordinate delivery sprints with frontend and backend developers \- break features into well\-defined tasks, clarify scope, and keep work unblocked.
 



 ● Drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that what is built matches what was specified before it reaches users.
 



 ● Own release management \- plan rollouts, maintain changelogs, and ensure smooth, low\-defect launches.
 



 ● Track product metrics post\-launch and use them to decide what to build, fix, or improve next.
 



 ● Communicate clearly and consistently with stakeholders — founders, engineers, and the
 



 teams who use the products every day.
 



  





**What You’ll Work On** 




 ● The customer app (PWA) — the homeowner's window into their solar journey: understanding quotes, making payments, e\-signing agreements, and tracking their project from order through installation and activation. You'll shape how confidently a first\-time solar buyer moves through that journey.
 



 ● The internal operations app — used by 100\+ team members across sales, execution, and support, with role\-based access. You'll sharpen the workflows that turn a signed order into an installed, energised system, cutting friction and manual work for the field.
 



 ● Payment and checkout experiences
 



 ● Reporting, dashboards, and product analytics — real\-time visibility into project pipelines, delivery status, and team performance, plus the instrumentation that tells you whether what you shipped is actually working.
 



 ● Onboarding and activation — how new customers and new internal users reach their first meaningful action quickly, with less hand\-holding.
 



 ● Customer communication and notifications — well\-timed, automated updates across WhatsApp, SMS, and in\-app channels that keep customers informed and reduce inbound support load — including content that works for Marathi\- and Hindi\-speaking users.
 



 ● Integrations, document workflows, and compliance — e\-signing, telephony, OTP/auth, and the generated documents (quotes, proposals, completion reports) and scheme/approval paperwork that customers and regulators depend on.
 



 ● AI\-assisted workflows — using LLMs and automation to cut manual effort as the product matures: summarising calls, drafting communication, and surfacing insights from operational data.
 



 Our stack: FlutterFlow (frontend), Supabase (backend, auth, edge functions), Make.com (automation), and GCP (microservices), with Easebuzz, Digio, and Exotel powering payments, e\-signing, and telephony. You won't need to code, but you'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the team that does.
 



  





**Good to Have:** 




 ● Exposure to low\-code / no\-code tools such as FlutterFlow or Supabase, or workflow automation platforms like Make.com.
 



 ● Familiarity with payment gateways, e\-signing, or telephony / communication integrations.
 



 ● Experience with product analytics and metrics instrumentation.
 



 ● A real interest in clean energy, climate, or the solar industry.
 



 ● Willingness to travel occasionally to our Nashik and Sangli offices to drive on\-ground adoption of newly launched features — not required, but a strong plus.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 ● Direct ownership of meaningful product surfaces from day one — no layers between you and impact.
 



 ● High visibility — work closely with the founding team and see how product decisions move the business.
 



 ● Breadth across the full product lifecycle, multiple applications, and live integrations.
 



 ● Compensation of ₹5\.5–6\.5 LPA, based on experience.
 



 ● Work that matters — accelerating the shift to clean, affordable energy for Indian homeowners.
 



 ● A fast\-paced, learning\-rich environment where you'll grow quickly.

title: Associate Product Manager - Retail Operations
description:
We're looking for an analytically sharp, execution\-oriented Associate Product Manager to work on our offline retail technology stack — spanning POS systems, supply chain operations, and SAP S/4 HANA integrations. You'll work at the intersection of business operations and technology, translating messy real\-world problems into well\-reasoned product solutions.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. You'll be expected to own outcomes, challenge assumptions, and bring a strong AI\-first lens to how we build and operate.
   

  

* Requirement definition — Work directly with business stakeholders to identify gaps, structure problem statements, and translate them into clear PRDs, user flows, and functional specs. Note: BRDs are authored by business teams; your job is to receive them, interrogate them, and convert them into actionable product specs.
* Solution design — Design end\-to\-end flows for new features and system enhancements across POS, inventory, and supply chain. Define acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity between business intent and engineering implementation.
* Testing \& validation — Write test cases, coordinate with QA, and drive UAT cycles to ensure features work the way they were intended — not just the way they were built.
* Issue resolution — Own RCA for production issues. Identify root causes, not just symptoms. Track recurring patterns and convert them into long\-term product improvements.
* AI\-first problem solving — Proactively identify where AI/ML tools, LLMs, or automation can eliminate manual effort, improve decision quality, or accelerate workflows across retail ops. You won't wait to be asked — you'll bring proposals.
* Cross\-functional coordination — Act as the connective tissue between business, engineering, QA, and operations. Drive clarity, not just communication.


**KPIs You Will Be Responsible For**
* P1/P2 incident resolution within defined SLAs; reduction in recurring production issues QoQ
* Post\-release defect rate and UAT sign\-off quality
* PRD cycle time — from stakeholder brief to engineering\-ready spec
* Store onboarding velocity for new POS/SAP rollouts (where applicable)
* Backlog hygiene — % of tickets with well\-defined acceptance criteria; sprint spillover rate


**Domain You Will Develop**
* SAP S/4 HANA — Stock transfer orders (STOs), goods receipt/issue flows, inventory reconciliation, POS\-ERP integration points. Deep SAP expertise is not a day\-one requirement.
* POS systems — Transaction flows, billing, returns, offline\-online sync, and store\-level operations.
* Supply chain — Inward/outward flows, inventory management, replenishment triggers, and inter\-warehouse operations.
* Omnichannel context — How offline retail operations connect to and depend on digital channels.


**What we are looking for?:**
* 1–3 years in product management or business analysis; retail, e\-commerce, or operations\-tech background preferred.
* Strong PRD and functional documentation skills — you write specs that engineers don't need to interpret.
* Comfort working in ambiguous environments where processes aren't always documented and systems don't always behave as expected.
* Genuine curiosity about AI tools — you explore, experiment, and look for ways to apply them before being asked.
* Strong analytical thinking; experience with RCA or structured problem\-solving methodologies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication — you can tell a business head and a backend engineer the same story in different languages.


**Good To Have**
* Hands\-on exposure to POS systems or offline retail operations
* Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems
* Experience in beauty, fashion, or lifestyle retail
* Working knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, or Whimsical


**Tools you will work with:** 
 Jira, Confluence, Whimsical, SAP S/4 HANA, Slack, AI tools
   

  

**Your Growth Path**
 0–6 months
   

  

* Ramp on domain (POS, SAP, supply chain).
* Own issue resolution and testing cycles.
* Deliver your first PRD independently.


 6–18 months
   

  

* Own a product sub\-area end\-to\-end.
* Drive feature roadmap inputs.
* Identify and implement AI\-assisted improvements to internal workflows.


 18–30 months
   

  

* Transition to Product Manager, owning a defined product area with full discovery\-to\-delivery accountability.
