title: Junior Cybersecurity / Network Engineer — Maritime OT/IT Security
description:
**About eDOT Solutions** 




 eDOT Solutions is a maritime technology and AI company headquartered in Vasco Da Gama, Goa, founded in 2004 by Capt. Ruchin C. Dayal (Master Mariner, President — IIMS UK). We build AI\-powered platforms for the global shipping industry, serving ship management companies, maritime training institutes, and flag states worldwide.
 



 Our team of 85 professionals spans development, design, maritime domain expertise, and laboratory operations. We operate six live AI products including IntellisNET, our maritime cybersecurity platform built to satisfy IMO Resolution MSC.428(98\) obligations under the ISM Code.
 



 IntellisNET was originally co\-developed with ClassNK (Nippon Kaiji Kyokai) in 2019 and is currently in active production development, moving toward global fleet deployment.
 



**What you will actually be doing** 




 This role sits at the intersection of two workstreams inside IntellisNET and you will contribute equally to both.
 



 Working with Rohit, our OT Risk Methodology Specialist:
 


* Learning and applying the IntellisNET risk scoring framework — a four\-pillar formula grounded in NIST SP 800\-82 and IEC 62443
* Assisting in building and maintaining the OT asset taxonomy database — the engine that pre\-populates equipment lists by vessel type, DWT, and build year
* Supporting the OEM whitelist construction — identifying and cataloguing authorised OEM network traffic signatures from technical documentation
* Helping validate risk assessment outputs against real vessel network scan data
* Growing your understanding of vessel network architecture — IDMZ, OT/IT segmentation, ECDIS, AIS, propulsion control systems



 Working with Dev 1, our Backend Developer:
 


* Supporting the NVD CVE pipeline — pulling vulnerability data from the National Vulnerability Database API, mapping CPE strings, and assigning CVSS scores to assets
* Assisting in building and testing the FRS (Finding Risk Score) calculation engine
* Supporting passive listener development — a system that monitors IDMZ boundary traffic to detect OT network breaches without active scanning
* Writing and running test cases for the scoring engine against worked examples
* Maintaining Python scripts used across the risk and scoring architecture



**The environment you will be working in** 




 Commercial vessels operate with a strict IT/OT network separation enforced by an IDMZ (Industrial Demilitarized Zone). OT assets — navigation systems, engine management, propulsion control — sit behind this boundary and cannot be actively scanned. Your work will help build the intelligence layer that monitors, scores, and reports on vessel cyber risk without ever touching the OT network directly.
 



 This is a domain where fewer than a handful of commercial platforms exist globally. The work you do here will not be replicated in a typical IT company environment.
 



**What we are looking for** 




 Essential:
 


* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics — 0 to 2 years of experience
* Solid fundamentals in TCP/IP networking — you must understand how packets move, what ports mean, and how network segments work
* Basic Linux command line comfort — you do not need to be a sysadmin, but you must not be afraid of a terminal
* Python scripting — not advanced, but able to read, write, and debug scripts
* Understanding of what a CVE is, what a CVSS score means, and where vulnerability data comes from
* Ability to work from a written specification document and ask the right questions when something is unclear
* Comfortable with numbers and formulas — the scoring engine involves real mathematics that must be implemented precisely



 Advantageous:
 


* Any exposure to Wireshark, Nmap, Zeek, or Suricata — even academic or self\-taught
* Familiarity with REST API consumption in Python
* Awareness of IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800\-82, even at introductory level
* Any project or coursework involving network security, packet analysis, or vulnerability assessment
* Exposure to maritime systems, vessel operations, or the shipping industry



**What we offer** 



* Permanent employment at eDOT Solutions headquarters, Vasco Da Gama, Goa
* Direct mentorship by experienced professionals
* Exposure to a live, globally deployed cybersecurity platform from your first week
* A clear growth path — this role is designed to develop into the permanent internal OT security engineering capability for IntellisNET as the platform scales
* The opportunity to work on a platform targeting approximately 55,000 vessels under IMO cyber mandate — a market that is at the very beginning of its technology adoption curve
* You will be joining at the point of transition from self\-funded R\&D to capital\-activated growth



**Who this role is not for** 



* Candidates looking for a frontend or mobile development position — this is backend, network, and data pipeline work only
* Candidates who want to work remotely — this role requires daily on\-site presence at our Goa office
* Candidates with no networking fundamentals — TCP/IP is not optional here



**How to apply** 




 Send a connection request or message via LinkedIn with a two or three sentence note on why this specific role interests you. No CV required at first contact. We will respond within 48 hours.
 



 eDOT Solutions does not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, or background. We hire on fundamentals, curiosity, and willingness to learn. If you have the networking basics and the drive to go deep, we want to hear from you.

​**Indeed Optimization Tips for Posting:**

* ​**Keep the Title Clean:** Avoid emojis or fluff like *"Hiring Urgently!! RockStar Recruiter"* in the actual Indeed title field. Keep it exactly as **HR Recruiter** or **Technical Recruiter**, and select the "Remote" checkbox during setup.

description:
Akanksha is on a mission to build one of the largest and most innovative networks of schools in India, serving children from low\-income communities, to maximize their potential. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

**Position: Computer Teacher**

**Function/Team:** Akanksha

**School Location:** Dadar (Mumbai)

**Compensation:** Based on skill sets, experience and sector standards

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary:**

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Title:** 
 System Administrator
 



**Job Location:** 
 Bopal, Ahmedabad
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  
 



**About the Company:** 




  
 



 OMSGuru is a 8\-year\-old software product company located in Bopal, Ahmedabad working in the eCommerce Industry. OMS Guru is a backbone for online eCommerce vendors and helps them grow their businesses profitably. We serve over 10000\+ happy clients who use our services. OMSGuru is built with single goal in mind: to help big \& small sellers and retailers manage their back\-end business operations with ease. Thank you for your interest in OMS Guru solutions private limited.
 



  
 



**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a skilled and experienced System Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our physical and virtual IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in server administration (Windows, Linux, and MacOS), networking, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/Proxmox), cloud (AWS), automation tools, security, and application hosting. You will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of systems and services across multiple platforms.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Install, configure, maintain, and monitor physical and virtual servers, desktops, and laptops.
* Manage network devices including firewalls, switches, routers, and GSM gateways.
* Configure and troubleshoot firewall, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, and routing policies.
* Implement and manage backup/restore solutions for VMs, databases, and applications.
* Manage virtualized environments (
 **VMware ESXi 8** 
 , Proxmox, Hyper\-V).
* Administer NAS/SAN storage and RAID configurations.
* Deploy and monitor web applications on IIS, Apache, and Nginx servers.
* Install and manage databases (MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Handle patch management and system updates for servers and network devices.
* Manage and integrate VoIP/SIP solutions with Asterisk servers.
* Monitor infrastructure using ELK Stack, Zabbix, NewRelic, Grafana with Slack/email alerts.
* Support Office 365 and Google Workspace users and policies.
* Maintain and secure GitLab server, version control, and source code access.
* Manage endpoint security via ESET Security Server.
* Troubleshooting software and hardware issues (desktops, laptops, servers).
* Configure and secure remote access using RDP, SSH, Telnet, SNMP.
* Deploy and maintain open\-source applications on Linux servers.
* Implement automation and integrations using Bash, PowerShell, Zapier, and n8n.
* Maintain inventory, licensing, and documentation for IT assets.
* Communicate with vendors and service providers for technical support.
* Ensure secure handling of passwords, API keys, and secrets using 2FA and encryption.



  
 



**Required Skills and Experience:** 



* **System Administration** 
 : Windows (2–5 years), Linux (2–5 years), MacOS
* **Networking** 
 : TCP/IP, VPNs, Routing, Firewall configuration, DNS, DHCP
* **Storage/Backup** 
 : SAN, RAID, NAS, disaster recovery, patching
* **Virtualization** 
 : VMware ESXi 8, Hyper\-V, Proxmox (2–3 years)
* **Cloud Platforms** 
 : AWS (EC2, S3, Route 53\)
* **Security** 
 : Endpoint protection, 2FA, patch management, network protocols
* **Databases** 
 : MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL
* **Monitoring** 
 : Zabbix, ELK, Grafana, NewRelic
* **Scripting** 
 : Bash, PowerShell (basic to intermediate level)
* **Automation Tools** 
 : Zapier, n8n
* **Communication** 
 : Work with vendors, document processes, team collaboration



  
 



  
 



**Qualification:** 



* **Education** 
 : B.E./B. Tech/BSc in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication
* **Certifications (Preferred)** 
 : RHCE, MCSA/MCSE, VMware, AWS, ITIL, CEH, or similar



  
 



**Additional Information:** 



* Availability for 24x7 on\-call support as per requirement
* Must maintain confidentiality and security best practices at all times



  
 



**How to Apply:** 




 Please send your resume on hr@omsguru.com

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer, Networking
description:
We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join a dynamic and results\-oriented team. The role requires a high level of routing and switching in the data center/AI/storage/HPC environments
   

  

 As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be an approachable, proficient communicator who is fundamentally interested in taking ownership in resolving issues, while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained and delivered. You will interact with Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams regularly on technical issues
   

  

 The standard work schedule for this role is Tuesday through Saturday.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Tier 3 support: installing, supporting, and resolving technical issues and challenges
* Develop \& present technical \& comprehensive solutions to customer problems, including the project management of complex installations
* Problem reporting, customer concern, replication, and resolution management
* Respond to customer technical inquiries
* Site visits and conference calls with customers and partners.
* Developing \& refining internal processes to improve support efficiency and productivity


**What We Need To See**
* B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software engineering, or Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of experience in providing Customer Support for hardware \& software products required
* Extensive knowledge and troubleshooting experience with network equipment and network protocols, including IP, L2, and L3 protocols required
* Extensive knowledge and troubleshooting experience with LAN Switching/routing (STP, MSTP, MLAG, VPC, VRRP, LACP) and routing \- IP Routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, PIM) and virtualization, EVPN, VXLAN
* Linux experience and scripting
* Automation \- Ansible
* The ability to work under pressure and support high\-level customers
* Experience with operating and configuring major vendors’ network equipment such as switches and routers
* Analysis and diagnosis of highly complicated networking problems
* Good communication and presentation/oral skills
* Excellent verbal and written English skills
* Tenacious, with good follow\-up, and attention to detail


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Knowledge of Linux/Unix (Administration level)
* Ethernet (10/40 GigE) and/or Infiniband
* Clustering or data center technologies including Upper Layer Protocols (i.e., MPI)
* Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to prioritize/multitask easily with limited supervision

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
location: Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, India
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Artificial Intelligence Engineer will work full time on\-site in Gautam Buddha Nagar, collaborating with designers, developers, and product stakeholders to build intelligent features into Wormos’s web and digital solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching, designing, and implementing machine learning models, optimizing algorithms for performance, and integrating AI components into production\-level software. The engineer will also evaluate new AI frameworks and tools, document technical approaches, and contribute to best practices for scalable and maintainable AI systems.

description:
**Job Title: Business Development Executive**

**Location:** Sector 83, Mohali

**Position:** Business Development Executive  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 Years

**About Us:** 

Offshore Marketers is a data\-driven digital marketing agency focused on delivering performance\-oriented solutions across SEO, paid ads, funnels, and automation. We are currently seeking a **Business Developer** with the experience of 1 to 3 Years who can bridge business needs with technical execution, helping us scale smarter and drive growth using insights, systems, and strategy.

**Role Overview:**

As a Business Developer, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams—including marketing, sales, and tech—to identify business opportunities, optimize workflows, and support data\-driven decision\-making. This role is ideal for someone who understands digital marketing ecosystems and wants to contribute strategically to business and product development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Business Requirement Gathering:** Work with stakeholders to collect, define, and translate business needs into functional requirements and project documentation.
* **Lead Funnel Analysis:** Analyze lead generation funnels and user journeys to identify bottlenecks, conversion drop\-offs, and opportunities for optimization using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, and CRM dashboards.
* **Lead Generation \& Revenue Contribution:** Strategically identify and utilize various online portals to generate qualified leads, nurture opportunities, and contribute directly to the company’s revenue pipeline.
* **Client Needs Mapping:** Conduct discovery calls and align client objectives with internal capabilities, translating business goals into measurable KPIs and performance metrics.
* **Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** Perform competitor benchmarking, trend forecasting, and audience segmentation using research platforms and data visualization tools.
* **Proposal \& SOW Documentation:** Create business proposals, technical documentation, and scope of work documents using a structured, data\-backed approach.
* **CRM \& Data Management:** Maintain data integrity within CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), generate reports, and build dashboards to track business development performance.
* **Process Automation Support:** Identify areas for workflow automation using tools like Zapier, Make (Integromat), or CRM\-native automation features.
* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Act as the liaison between business, marketing, and technical teams to ensure the successful implementation of growth and campaign strategies.

**Technical \& Core Skills Required:**

* **Basic Analytical Tools:** Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for reporting and simple data analysis (e.g., filters, charts, basic formulas).
* **CRM Familiarity:** Hands\-on experience or basic understanding of any CRM platform like Zoho, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel to manage leads and track client interactions.
* **Digital Marketing Awareness:** General understanding of how online funnels, paid ads, and email campaigns work. Experience working with teams using tools like MailerLite, Meta Ads Manager, or Systeme.io is a plus.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to create structured documents such as client briefs, simple reports, and workflow outlines using MS Word, Google Docs, or Notion.

* **Problem Solving:** Ability to identify issues, think critically, and suggest practical solutions based on available data.
* **Organizational Tools:** Comfortable using basic project management tools like Trello, ClickUp, or Google Calendar to manage tasks and timelines.
